Ka an-anayan ne baseen te

The first document of

Krunikas

Chronicles

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka An-anayan wey ka Ikarangeb ne Baseen te Krunikas migguhud ded degma te Baseen ni Samwil wey te Baseen te Me Hari piru nahuhud te lein ne paahi. Duen de daruwa ne impurtanti amana ne tuyu ke mania te nasulat ka nabaybayaan te me matig-Israil wey ka pegmandu te me Hari:

The First and the Second Document of Krunikas just also story about the Document by Samwil and the Document of/about Kings but instead by a different manner/way. There_are just two very important goals why what_ the (ones) from_Israil _went_through and the reigning of kings were_written:

1/ Eyew egkanengnengan te talagbasa ne minsan pad te kareetan ne nabayaan te Huda wey te Israil, intuman ded te Manama ka saad din wey ka implanu rin diye te keet-etawan. Impamalehetan seini te talagsulat pinaahi te pegpangguhud din te neneyimu ni Dabid, ni Sulumun, ni Hihusapat, ni Isikiyas, ni Husiyas, wey diye te me etew ne matinumanen te Manama.

1/ So_that the reader could_know that even_though Huda and Israil went_through destruction, God (MS Manama) still obeyed/fulfilled his promise and what_ he _planned there for the people. This is_testified by the writer by_means of his storying concerning what_was_done by Dabid, by Sulumun, by Hihusapat, by Isikiyas, by Husiyas, and by people that (were) faithful to God.

2/ Eyew te pegpahunsiling diye te keet-etawan ke egmenuwen te egsimba ka Manama diye te timplu rin ne diye te Hirusalim labew te langun diye te me talagpanubad wey me Libita ne iyan eggimu te pegsimba. Ne migpataha man-e seini ne si Dabid ka malehet ne pabunsuranan te timplu minsan ke si Sulumun e ka nakapasasindeg kayi.

2/ In_order for describing there to the people how to worship God there in his temple there in Hirusalim above all there for the sacrificers and Libitas who do the worshiping. And this also explains that Dabid (is) the correct founder of the temple even if Sulumun (was) the (one who) built it.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Adan

The descendants of Adan

(Hin 5:1‑32; 10:1‑3 10:1‑32; 11:10‑2 11:10‑26)

(Gen 5:1‑32; 10:1‑3 10:1‑32; 11:10‑2 11:10‑26)

11 Si Adan ka amey ni Sit, si Sit ka amey ni Inus, wey si Inus ka amey ni Kinan, 2 si Kinan ka amey ni Mahalalil, wey si Mahalalil ka amey ni Harid, 3 si Harid ka amey ni Inuk, si Inuk ka amey ni Mitusila, si Mitusila ka amey ni Lamik, wey si Lamik ka amey ni Nuwi. 4 Ne si Nuwi due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Sim, si Ham, wey si Hapit.

11 Adan (was) the father of Sit, Sit (was) the father of Inus, and Inus (was) the father of Kinan, 2 Kinan (was) the father of Mahalalil, and Mahalalil (was) the father of Harid, 3 Harid (was) the father of Inuk, Inuk (was) the father of Mitusila, Mitusila (was) the father of Lamik, and Lamik was the father of Nuwi. 4 And Nuwi had three male children who (were) Sim, Ham, and Hapit.

5 Ne seini ka me lukes ne anak ni Hapit—si Gumir, si Magug, si Maday, si Haban, si Tubal, si Misik, wey si Tiras. 6 Ne seini ka me lukes ne anak degma ni Gumir—si Askinas, si Ripat, wey si Tuggarma. 7 Seini ka me lukes ne anak ni Haban—si Ilisa, si Tarsis, si Kitim, wey si Rudanim.

5 These (are) the male children of Hapit—Gumir, Magug, Maday, Haban, Tubal, Misik, and Tiras. 6 These (are) the male children of Gumir—Askinas, Ripat, and Tuggarma. 7 These (are) the male children of Haban—Ilisa, Tarsis, Kitim, and Rudanim.

8 Ne seini ka me lukes ne anak ni Ham—si Kus, si Ihiptu,[fn] si Put, wey si Kanaan. 9 Seini degma ka me lukes ne anak ni Kus—si Siba, si Habila, si Sabta, si Raama, wey si Sabtika. Ne seini degma ka me lukes ne anak ni Raama—si Siyiba wey si Didan. 10 Ne duen pad man-e anak ni Kus ne egngaranan ki Nimrud, ne iyan ka an-anayan ne bahani kayi te ampew te tane. 11 Si Ihiptu iyan ka kaapuan te me matig-Ludim, me matig-Anamim, me matig-Lihabim, me matig-Naptuhim, 12 me matig-Patrusim, me matig-Kasluhim (ne inligkatan te me Pilistihanen), wey me matig-Kapturim. 13 Ka panganey ne anak ni Kanaan iyan si Sidun, ne kaapuan te me Sidunihanen wey te me Hitihanen, 14 me Hibusihanen, me Amurihanen, me Girgasihanen, 15 me Hibihanen, me Arkihanen, me Sinihanen, 16 me Arbadihanen, me Simarihanen, wey te me Hamatihanen.

8 And these (are) the male children of Ham—Kus, Ihiptu,[fn] Put, and Kanaan. 9 These are also the male children of Kus—Siba, Habila, Sabta, Raama, and Sabtika. And these are also the male children of Raama—Siyiba and Didan. 10 And Kus has another child named Nimrud, who was the first warrior here on the top of the earth. 11 Ihiptu (was) the ancestor of the (ones) from_Ludim, the (ones) from_Anam, the (ones) from_Lihabim, the (ones) from_Naptuhim, 12 the (ones) from_Patrusim, the (ones) from_Kasluhim (which (are) the source of Pilistihanons), and the (ones) from_Kapturim. 13 The eldest child of Kanaan (was) Sidun, the ancestor of the Sidunihanons and of the Hitihanons, 14 Hibusihanons, Amurihanons, Girgasihanons, 15 Hibihanons, Arkihanons, Sinihanons, 16 Arbadihanons, Simarihanons, and Hamatihanons.

17 Ne seini ka me lukes ne anak ni Sim—si Ilam, si Asur, si Arpaksad, si Lud, wey si Aram, si Us, si Hul, si Gitir, wey si Misik. 18 Ne si Arpaksad ka amey ni Sila, wey si Sila ka amey ni Ibir. 19 Ne si Ibir due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes. Ka ngaran te sabeka, si Pilig[fn] su te timpu rin, nabaad ka keet-etawan[fn] te kalibutan. Ne ka ngaran te suled din iyan si Huktan. 20 Ne si Huktan ka amey ni Almudad, ni Silip, ni Asarmabit, ni Hira, 21 ni Aduram, ni Usal, ni Dikla, 22 ni Ibal, ni Abimail, ni Siyiba, 23 ni Upir, ni Habila, wey ni Hubab.

17 And these were the male children of Sim—Ilam, Asur, Arpaksad, Lud, Aram, Us, Hul, Gitir, and Misik. 18 And Arpaksad (was) the father of Sila, and Sila was the father of Ibir. 19 And Ibir had two male children. The name of one, (was) Pilig[fn] because in his time, the people[fn] of the world were_divided. And the name of his brother (was) Huktan. 20 And Huktan (was) the father of Almudad, of Silip, of Asarmabit, of Hira, 21 of Aduram, of Usal, of Dikla, 22 of Ibal, of Abimail, of Siyiba, 23 of Upir, of Habila, and of Hubab.

24 Te pantek ne peglista te me kabuhalan ni Sim: si Arpaksad, si Sila, 25 si Ibir, si Pilig, si Riyu, 26 si Sirug, si Nahur, si Tira, 27 wey si Abram ka neilaan degma ne Abraham.

24 In short listing of descendants of Sim: Arpaksad, Sila, 25 Ibir, Pilig, Riyu, 26 Sirug, Nahur, Tira, 27 and Abram the (one) also known as Abraham.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Ismail

The descendants of Ismail

(Hin 25:12‑16)

(Gen 25:12‑16)

28 Ne due daruwa ne anak ni Abraham ne me lukes ne iyan si Isaak wey si Ismail. 29 Seini ka me lukes ne anak ni Ismail—si Nibayut (ka kinakakayan), si Kidar, si Adbiil, si Mibsam, 30 si Misma, si Duma, si Masa, si Hadad, si Tima, 31 si Hitur, si Napis, wey si Kidima. 32 Ne ka me lukes ne anak ni Abraham ki Kitura ne duwey rin iyan si Simran, si Huksan, si Midan, si Midiyan, si Isbak, wey si Suwa. Ne ka me anak ni Huksan ne me lukes, iyan si Siyiba wey si Didan. 33 Ne ka me anak ni Midiyan ne me lukes, iyan si Ipa, si Ipir, si Hanuk, si Abida, wey si Ildiya. Me kabuhalan sikandan langun ni Kitura.

28 And there were two male children of Abraham that were Isaak and Ismail. 29 These (are) the male children of Ismail—Nibayut (the oldest), Kidar, Adbiil, Mibsam, 30 Misma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tima, 31 Hitir, Napis, and Kidima. 32 And the male children by Abraham with Kitura his junior_wife (were) Simran, Huksan, Midan, Midiyan, Isbak, and Suwa. And the male children of Huksan, (were) Siyiba and Didan. 33 And the male children of Midiyan, (were) Ipa, Ipir, Hanuk, Abida, and Ildiya. They (were) all descendants of Kitura.

34 Ne si Abraham ka amey ni Isaak. Ne ka me anak ni Isaak ne me lukes, iyan si Isaw wey si Hakub.

34 And Abraham (was) the father of Isaak. And the male children of Isaak, (were) Isaw and Hakub.

Ka me Hari te inged ne Idum

The kings of place of Idum

(Hin 36:31‑43)

(Gen 36:31‑43)

43 Seini ka me Hari te inged ne Idum te me timpu ne ware pad mighari diye te Israil: si Bila ne anak ni Biyur. Ne iyan ngaran te siyudad din ka Dinhaba. 44 Te migpatey e si Bila, iyan nakasubal kandin migmandu si Hubab ne anak ni Sira ne matig-Busra. 45 Te migpatey e degma si Hubab, iyan e degma nakasubal kandin migmandu si Husam ne matig-Timan. 46 Te migpatey e degma si Husam, iyan e degma nakasubal kandin migmandu ka anak ni Bidad ne si Hadad ne matig-Abit. Natalu ni Hadad ka me matig-Midiya diye te napu te Muwab. 47 Te migpatey e degma si Hadad, iyan e degma nakasubal kandin migmandu si Samla ne matig-Masrika. 48 Te migpatey e degma si Samla, iyan e degma nakasubal kandin migmandu si Saul ne matig-Rihubut ne marani te Weyig ne Iyupratis. 49 Te migpatey e degma si Saul, iyan e degma nakasubal kandin migmandu si Baal-Hanan ne anak ni Akbur. 50 Te migpatey e degma si Baal-Hanan, iyan e degma nakasubal kandin migmandu si Hadad ne matig-Pau. Ne ka asawa ni Hadad iyan si Mihitabil ne anak ni Matrid wey apu ni Misaab.

43 These (are) the kings of place of Idum at the time before (anyone) reigned there in Israil: Bila the child of Biyur. And the name of his city (was) Dinhaba. 44 When Bila had_died, the (one who) replaced him in ruling (was) Hubab the child of Sira from_Busra. 45 When Hubab also had_died, the (one also who) replaced him ruling (was) Husam from_Timan. 46 When Husam also had_died, the (one also who) replaced him ruling (was) the child of Bidad who's Hadad from_Abit. Hadad defeated the (ones) from_Midiyan there on the plain of Muwab. 47 When Hadad also had_died, the (one also who) replaced him ruling (was) Samla from_Masrika. 48 When Samla also died, the (one also who) replaced him ruling (was) Saul from_Rihubut near the River Iyupratis. 49 When Saul also had_died, the (one also who) replaced him ruling (was) Baal-Hanan the child of Akbur. 50 When Baal-Hanan also had_died, the (one also who) replaced him ruling (was) Hadad from_Pau. And the spouse of Hadad (was) Mihitabil the child of Matrid and grandchild of Misaab.

51 Ne nataman migpatey e degma si Hadad.

51 Then later on Hadad also had_died.

Seini ka me pangulu te tribu te Ilam: si Timna, si Alya, si Hatit,52 si Uhulibama, si Ila, si Pinun, 53 si Kinas, si Timan, si Mibsar, 54 si Magdiil, wey si Iram.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Huda

The descendants of Huda

3 Ne ka me anak ni Huda ne me lukes iyan si Ir, si Unan, wey si Sila. Seini se tatelu, anak dan ki Batsuwa ne Kanaanen. Si Ir ne kinakakayan ne anak ni Huda, mareet se hinimuwan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, purisu innimatayan sikandin te Manama. 4 Duen pad man-e daruwa ne anak ni Huda ne me lukes ki Tamar ne ambey rin ne iyan si Piris wey si Sira. Lalimma langun ka anak din ne me lukes.

3 Then the male children of Huda (were) Ir, Unan, and Sila. These three, (were) their children of Batsuwa the Kanaanon. Ir the oldest child of Huda, (his) actions (were) bad there in front of the Lord God, therefore he was_killed by God. 4 There_were also two more male children of Huda with Tamar his daughter-in-law who (were) Piris and Sira. All his male children (numbered) five.

5 Ne due daruwa ne anak ni Piris ne me lukes ne iyan si Hisrun wey si Hamul. 6 Ne ka anak ni Sira ne me lukes iyan si Simri, si Itan, si Himan, si Kalkul, wey si Dara. Lalimma langun ka anak din ne me lukes. 7 [xr]Ne sabeka te me kabuhalan ni Sira ne iyan si Karmi, due anak ne lukes ne iyan si Akan, ne nekeyimu te kahubut te Israil pinaahi te pegpanakew rin te kasangkapan ne imbehey e diye te Manama. 8 Ne ka anak ni Itan ne lukes iyan si Asariyas.

5 And there were two male children of Piris who (were) Hisrun and Hamul. 6 And the male children of Sira (were) Simri, Itan, Himan, Kalkul, and Dara. All his male children (numbered) five. 7 [xr]And Karmi one of the descendants of Sira, have a male child who was_(particularly) Akan, who made a disturbance in Israil by_means_of his stealing of utensils that had_been_given there to God. 8 And the male child of Itan (was) Asariyas.

Ka kaap-apuan ni Hari Dabid

The ancestors of King Dabid

9 Ne ka anak ni Hisrun ne me lukes iyan si Hiramil, si Ram, wey si Kalib.[fn]

9 And the male children of Hisrun (were) Hiramil, Ram, and Kalib.[fn]

10 Si Ram ka amey ni Aminadab, wey si Aminadab ka amey ni Naasun, ne pangulu te keet-etawan te Huda. 11 Si Naasun ka amey ni Salmun, wey si Salmun ka amey ni Buas. 12 Si Buas ka amey ni Ubid, wey si Ubid ka amey ni Hisi. 13 Ne due pitu ne anak ni Hisi ne me lukes: si Iliyab ka kinakakayan, si Aminadab ka igkarangeb, si Simiya ka igkatelu, 14 si Nitanil ka igkeep-at, si Raday ka igkalimma, 15 si Usim ka igkeen-em, wey si Dabid ka igkapitu. 16 Ne due degma daruwa ne anak ni Hisi ne me malitan ne iyan si Siruya wey si Abigail. Ne si Siruya due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Abisay, si Huwab, wey si Asahil. 17 Ne si Abigail due anak din ne lukes ne iyan si Amasa, si Hitir ka amey rin ne sabeka ne Ismailita.

10 Ram (was) the father of Aminadab, and Aminadab (was) the father of Naasun, the leader of the people of Huda. 11 Naasun (was) the father of Salmun, and Salmun (was) the father of Buas. 12 Buas (was) the father of Ubid, and Ubid (was) the father of Hisi. 13 And Hisi had seven male child: Ilyab was the oldest, Abinadab (was) the second, Simiya (was) the third, 14 Nitanil (was) the fourth, Raday (was) the fifth, 15 Usim (was) the sixth, and Dabid (was) the seventh. 16 And Hisi had also two female child who (were) Siruya and Abigail. And Siruya had three male children who were (particularly) Abisay, Huwab, and Asahil. 17 And Abigail had a male child Amasa, and Hitir was his father (was) a (LIT one) Ismailita.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Kalib

The descendants of Kalib

18 Ne si Kalib ne anak ni Hisrun, migpangasawa ki Asuba ne egngaranan ded ki Hiriyut. Ne ka me anak dan ne me lukes iyan si Hisir, si Subab, wey si Ardun. 19 Te migpatey e si Asuba, mig-asawe e man-e si Kalib ki Iprata wey nakaanak sikandan ki Hur. 20 Ne si Hur ka amey ni Uri, wey si Uri ka amey ni Bisalil.

18 And Kalib the child of Hisrun, married Asuba also named Hiriyut. And their children were (particularly) Hisir, Subab, and Ardun. 19 When Asuba had_died, Kalib married again to Iprata and they bore Hur. 20 And Hur (was) the father of Uri, and Uri (was) the father of Bisalil.

21 Te hen-em ne pulu (60) e ka idad ni Hisrun, impangasawa rin e ka anak ni Makir ka an-anayan ne mahinged te Gilyad. Ne nakaanak sikandan te lukes ne iyan si Sigub. 22 Ne si Sigub ka amey ni Hair. Ne si Hair ka migmandu te daruwa ne pulu wey tatelu (23) ne me siyudad ne sakup te Gilyad. 23 Piru in-ahew ni Gisur wey ni Aram ka me lungsud ne immanduan ni Hair lagkes ka Kinat, wey ka hen-em ne pulu (60) ne me bariyu ne nakalingut kayi. Me kabuhalan langun ni Makir ne amey ni Gilyad ka nangugpe te seini ne me lungsud wey me bariyu. 24 Te migpatey e si Hisrun, si Kalib ne anak din miggilabet ki Iprata ne balu te amey rin, wey nakaanak si Iprata ki Asur ne amey ni Tikuwa.

21 When Hisrun was sixty (60) years old, he married the child of Makir the first locals of Gilyad. And she bore a male who (was) Sigub. 22 And Sigub (was) the father of Hair. And Hair (was) the (one who) ruled twenty-three (23) cities which under_the_jurisdiction of Gilyad. 23 Therefore the towns ruled by Hair including Kinat were_snatched by Gisur and Aram, and the sixty (60) barrios that surrounded it. All descendants of Makir the father of Gilyad the (ones who) lived of these towns and villages. 24 When Hisrun had_died, his child Kalib intercoursed Iprata the widow of his father, and Iprata bore Asur the father of Tikuwa.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Hiramil

The descendants of Hiramil

25 Ne si Hiramil, ne kinakakayan ne anak ni Hisrun, due lalimma ne anak ne me lukes: si Ram ka kinakakayan, si Buna ka igkarangeb, si Urin ka igkatelu, si Usin ka igkeep-at, wey si Ahiyas ka igkalimma. 26 Ne duen pad man-e lein ne asawa ni Hiramil ne egngaranan ki Atara ne iney ni Unam. 27 Ne si Ram ne kinakakayan ne anak ni Hiramil, due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Maas, si Hamin, wey si Ikir. 28 Ne si Unam due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Samay wey si Hada. Ne si Samay due degma daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Nadab wey si Abisur.

25 And Hiramil, the oldest child of Hisrun, had five male children: Ram (was) the oldest, Buna (was) the second, Urin (was) the third, Usin (was) the fourth, and Ahiyas (was) the fifth. 26 And there_was also another spouse of Hiramil named Atara who (was) the mother of Unam. 27 And Ram the oldest child of Hiramil, had male children who (were) Maas, Hamin, and Ikir. 28 And Unam had two male children who (were) Samay and Hada. And Samay also had two male children who (were) Nadab and Abisur.

29 Ne ka ngaran te asawa ni Abisur iyan si Abihail. Ne due anak dan ne me lukes ne iyan si Aban wey si Mulid. 30 Ne si Nadab due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Silid wey si Apayim. Ne migpatey re due si Silid ne ware anak. 31 Ne ka anak ni Apayim ne lukes iyan si Ishi. Ne si Ishi ka amey ni Sisan wey si Sisan ka amey ni Alay.

29 And the name of the spouse of Abisur (was) Abihail. And they had male children who (were) Aban and Mulid. 30 And Nadab had two male children who (were) Silid and Apayim. And Silid just died with_no child. 31 And the male child of Apayim (was) Ishi. And Ishi (was) the father of Sisan and Sisan (was) the father of Alay.

32 Ne si Hada ne suled ni Samay due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hitir wey si Diyunatan. Ne migpatey re due si Hitir ne ware anak. 33 Ne si Diyunatan due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Pilit wey si Sasa. Sikandan langun ka me kabuhalan ni Hiramil.

32 And Hada the sibling/cousin of Samay had two male children who (were) Hitir and Diyunatan. And Hitir just died with_no child. 33 Then Diyunatan had two males children who (were) Pilit and Sasa. They_were all the descendants of Hiramil.

34 Ne si Sisan ware anak ne me lukes, su me malitan de. Piru due uripen din ne lukes ne matig-Ihiptu ne egngaranan ki Harha. 35 Purisu, impaasawa rin ki Harha ne uripen din ka sabeka te me anak din ne malitan wey nakaanak sikandan ki Atay. 36 Ne si Atay ka amey ni Natan, wey si Natan ka amey ni Sabad. 37 Ne si Sabad ka amey ni Iplal, wey si Iplal ka amey ni Ubid. 38 Ne si Ubid ka amey ni Dihu, wey si Dihu ka amey ni Asariyas. 39 Ne si Asariyas ka amey ni Hilis, wey si Hilis ka amey ni Ilasa. 40 Ne si Ilasa ka amey ni Sismay, wey si Sismay ka amey ni Salum. 41 Ne si Salum ka amey ni Hikamiyas, wey si Hikamiyas ka amey ni Ilisama.

34 And Sisan had_no male children, but rather just females. But he had a male slave from_Ihiptu named Harha. 35 Therefore, he married_off to Harha his servant one of his female child and they bore Atay. 36 And Atay (was) the father of Natan, and Natan (was) the father of Sabad. 37 And Sabad (was) the father of Iplal, and Iplal (was) the father of Ubid. 38 And Ubid (was) the father of Dihu, and Dihu (was) the father of Asariyas. 39 And Asariyas (was) the father of Hilis, and Hilis (was) the father of Ilasa. 40 And Ilasa (was) the father of Sismay, and Sismay (was) the father of Salum. 41 And Salum (was) the father of Hikamiyas, and Hikamiyas (was) the father of Ilisama.

Ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Kalib

The other descendants of Kalib

42 Ne ka me lukes ne anak te suled ni Hiramil ne si Kalib, iyan si Misa ka panganey, ne amey ni Sip, wey si Marisa ka igkarangeb, ne amey ni Hibrun. 43 Ne ka me anak ni Hibrun ne me lukes iyan si Kura, si Tapuwa, si Rikim, wey si Sima. 44 Ne si Sima ka amey ni Raham, wey si Raham ka amey ni Hurkiyam. Ne si Rikim ka amey ni Samay, 45 si Samay ka amey ni Maun, wey si Maun ka amey ni Bitsur. 46 Ne due duwey ni Kalib ne egngaranan ki Ipa ne nakaanak engki Haran, ki Musa, wey ki Gasis. Ne si Haran due anak ne lukes ne egngaranan degma ki Gasis. 47 Ne si Haday due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Rigim, si Hutam, si Gisan, si Pilit, si Ipa, wey si Saap.

42 And the male children of the sibling/cousin of Hiramil that's Kalib, (were) Misa the eldest, that's the father of Sip, and Marisa the second, that's the father of Hibrun. 43 And the male children of Hibrun (were) Kura, Tapuwa, Rikim, and Sima. 44 And Sima (was) the father of Raham, and Raham (was) the father of Hurkiyam. And Rikim (was) the father of Samay, 45 Samay (was) the father of Maun, and Maun (was) the father of Bitsur. 46 And there_was a junior_wife of Kalib named Ipa who bore Haran, Musa, and Gasis. And Haran had a male child also named Gasis. 47 And Haday had male children who (were) Rigim, Hutam, Gisan, Pilit, Ipa, and Saap.

48 Ne duen pad man-e lein ne duwey ni Kalib ne iyan si Maaka, ne nakaanak ki Sabir wey ki Tirhana. 49 Ne nakaanak pad man-e si Maaka te daruwa ne me lukes ne si Saap ne amey ni Madmana, wey si Siba ne amey ni Makbina wey ni Gibiya. Ne due man-e anak ni Kalib ne malitan ne iyan si Aksa.

48 And there_was also a different junior_wife of Kalib who (was) Maaka, that bore Sabir and Tirhana. 49 And Maaka also bore two males that (were) Saap the father of Madmana, and Siba the father of Makbina and of Gibiya. And there_was also a female child of Kalib who (was) Aksa.

50 Ne seini pad man-e ka me kabuhalan ni Kalib: si Hur ne kinakakayan ne anak ni Kalib ki Iprata, due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Subal ne iyan migpasasindeg te siyudad ne Kiryat-Hiyarim, 51 si Salma ne iyan migpasasindeg te siyudad ne Bitlihim, wey si Harip iyan migpasasindeg te Bitgadir. 52 Ne si Subal ka migpasasindeg siyudad te Kiryat-Hiyarim. Ka me kabuhalan din iyan ka me matig-Haruwi wey ka katenge te me matig-Minuhut. 53 Ne ka me kabuhalan ne nangugpe diye te Kiryat-Hiyarim iyan ka me Itrahanen, me Puthanen, me Sumatnen, wey ka me Misrahanen—me kabuybuyahan te me Suruhanen wey me Istaulnen. 54 Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Salma iyan ka me matig-Bitlihim, me matig-Nitupa, me matig-Astrubitihuwab, wey ka katenge te me matig-Manahat wey me matig-Suri. 55 Ne ka me kabuhalan te me mangngateu ne egsulat wey eg-iling te me sinulat, diye mig-ugpe te Habis. Sikandan ka me Tiratihanen, me Simiyatihanen, wey me Sukatihanen. Sikandan ka me Kinihanen ne migpuun ki Hamat ne amey ni Rikab.

50 And these also were another descendants of Kalib: Hur the oldest child of Kalib with Iprata, had male children who (were) Subal was the (one)_who built (LIT caused_to_stand) the city of Kiryat-Hiyarim, 51 Salma was the (one)_who built (LIT caused_to_stand) the city of Bitlihim, and Harip the (one)_who built (LIT caused_to_stand) the Bitgadir. 52 And Subal the (one) who_built (LIT caused_to_stand) the city of Kiryat-Hiyarim. His descendants (were) the (ones) from_Haruwi and half of the (ones) from_Minuhut. 53 And the descendants that lived there in Kiryat-Hiyarim (were) the Itrahanons, Puthanons, Sumatnos, and the Misrahanons—elders of the Suruhanons and Istaulnons. 54 And the decendants of Salma (were) the (ones) from_Bitlihim, those_from Nitupa, the (ones) from_Astrubitihuwab, and half of those from Manahat and the (ones) from_Suri. 55 And the descendants of the experts in writing and copying the documents, lived in Habis. They (were) Tiratihanons, Simiyatihanons, and Sukatihanons. They (were) the Kinihanons that came_from Hamat the father of Rikab.

Ka me anak ni Hari Dabid

The children of King Dabid

31 Seini ka anak ni Dabid ne me lukes ne neneetew diye te Hibrun: si Amun ka kinakakayan ne iyan iney si Ahinuwam ne matig-Hisril. Si Danyil ka igkarangeb ne iyan iney si Abigail ne matig-Karmil. 2 Si Absalum ka igkatelu ne iyan iney si Maaka ne anak ni Talmay ne Hari te Gisur. Si Aduniyas ka igkeep-at ne iyan iney si Hagit. 3 Si Sipatiyas ka igkalimma ne iyan iney si Abital. Ne si Itriyam ka igkeen-em ne iyan iney si Igla.

31 These (are) the male children of Dabid that were_born(pl) in Hibrun: Amun (was) the oldest and the mother was Ahinuwam from_Hisril. Danyil (was) the second and the mother (was) Abigail from_Karmil. 2 Absalum (was) the third and the mother (was) Maaka the child of Talmay the king of Gisur. Aduniyas (was) the fourth and the mother (was) Hagit. 3 Sipatiyas (was) the fifth and the mother (was) Abital. And Itriyam (was) the sixth and the mother (was) Igla.

4 [xr]Ne seini se hen-em, neneetew diye te Hibrun te timpu ne mighari si Dabid diye te pitu ne leg-un wey hen-em ne bulan.

4 [xr]And these six, were_born(pl) there in Hibrun at the time that Dabid kinged there for seven years and six months.

Ne mighari si Dabid diye te Hirusalim te tatelu ne pulu wey tatelu (33) ne leg-un.5 [xr]Ne seini ka me anak ni Dabid ne me lukes ne neneetew diye te Hirusalim: si Simiya, si Subab, si Natan, wey si Sulumun. Seini se hep-at, me anak dan ki Batsiba ne anak ni Amil. 6 Ne duen pad man-e siyam ne anak ni Dabid ne me lukes ne iyan si Ibaar, si Ilisama, si Ilpilit, 7 si Nugi, si Nipig, si Hapiya, 8 si Ilisama, si Iliyada, wey si Ilipilit. 9 Sika langun ka me anak ni Dabid, ware labet te me anak din te me duwey rin. Ne due degma anak din ne malitan ne si Tamar.

And Dabid kinged there in Hirusalim for thirty-three (33) years.5 [xr]And these (were) the male children of Dabid who were_born(pl) there in Hirusalim: Simiya, Subab, Natan, and Sulumun. These four, they (were) the children of Batsiba the child of Amil. 6 And there were also nine male children of Dabid that_were Ibaar, Ilisama, Ilpilit, 7 Nugi, Nipig, Hapiya, 8 Ilisama, Iliyada, and Ilipilit. 9 Those were all the children of Dabid, not including his children from his junior_wives. And he also had a female child Tamar.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Hari Sulumun

The descendants of King Sulumun

10 Seini ka me kabuhalan ni Sulumun ne neneyimu ne Hari: si Rihubuwam, si Abiyas, si Asa, si Hihusapat, 11 si Huram, si Ahasiyas, si Huwas, 12 si Amasiyas, si Asariyas, si Hutam, 13 si Ahas, si Isikiyas, si Manasis, 14 si Amun, wey si Husiyas. 15 Ne seini ka hep-at ne me lukes ne anak ni Husiyas: si Diyuhanan, si Huwakim, si Sidikiyas, wey si Salum. 16 Ne seini ka me anak ni Huwakim: si Huwakin wey si Sidikiyas.

10 These (are) the descendants of Sulumun that became(pl) king: Rihubuwam, Abiyas, Asa, Hihusapat, 11 Huram, Ahasiyas, Huwas, 12 Amasiyas, Asariyas, Hutam, 13 Ahas, Isikiyas, Manasis, 14 Amun, and Husiyas. 15 And these (are) the four male children of Husiyas: Diyuhanan, Huwakim, Sidikiyas, and Salum. 16 And these (are) the children of Huwakim: Huwakin and Sidikiyas.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Hari Huwakin

The descendants of King Huwakin

17 Ne seini ka me kabuhalan ni Hari Huwakin ne impandakep wey impanguyan te me matig-Babilunya: si Salatiil, 18 si Malkiram, si Pidayas, si Sinisar, si Hikamiyas, si Husama, wey si Nidabiyas. 19 Ne si Pidayas due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Sirubabil wey si Simii. Ne si Sirubabil due degma daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Misulam wey si Ananiyas, wey due atebey ran ne si Silumit. 20 Ne duen pad man-e lalimma ne anak ni Sirubabil ne me lukes ne iyan si Hasuba, si Uhil, si Birikiyas, si Hasadiyas, wey si Husabisid. 21 Ne due degma daruwa ne anak ni Ananiyas ne me lukes ne iyan si Pilatiyas wey si Hisayas. Si Hisayas ka amey ni Ripayas, si Ripayas ka amey ni Arnan, si Arnan ka amey ni Ubadiya, wey si Ubadiya ka amey ni Sikaniyas. 22 Ne si Sikaniyas due sabeka ne anak ne lukes ne iyan si Simaya. Ne si Simaya due hen-em ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hatus, si Igal, si Bariya, si Naariyas, wey si Sapat. 23 Ne si Naariyas due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Iliyunay, si Iskiyas, wey si Asrikam. 24 Ne si Iliyunay due pitu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hudabiyas, si Iliyasib, si Pilayas, si Akub, si Diyuhanan, si Dilayas, wey si Anani.

17 And these (are) the descendants of King Huwakin that was_captured and taken_away by the (ones) from_Babilunya: Salatiil, 18 Malkiram, Pidayas, Sinisar, Hikamiyas, Husama, and Nidabiyas. 19 And Pidayas had two male children who (were) Sirubabil and Simii. And Sirubabil had also two male children who (were) Misulam and Ananiyas, and they had a sister Silumit. 20 And there_were also five other male children of Sirubabil who (were) Hasuba, Uhul, Birikiyas, Hasadiyas, and Husabisid. 21 And Ananiyas had also two male children who (were) Pilatiyas and Hisayas. Hisayas (was) the father of Ripayas, Ripayas (was) the father of Arnan, Arnan (was) the father of Ubadiya, and Ubadiya (was) the father of Sikaniyas. 22 And Sikaniyas had one male child Simaya. And Simaya had six male children who (were) Hatus, Igal, Bariya, Naariyas, and Sapat. 23 And Naariyas had three male children who (were) Iliyunay, Iskiyas, and Asrikam. 24 And Iliyunay had seven male children who (were) Hudabiyas, Iliyasib, Pilayas, Akub, Diyuhanan, Dilayas, and Anani.

Ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Huda

The other descendants of Huda

41 Seini ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Huda: si Piris, si Hisrun, si Karmi, si Hur, wey si Subal. 2 Ne si Subal ka amey ni Rayas, si Rayas ka amey ni Diyahat, wey si Diyahat ka amey ni Ahumay wey ni Lahad. Sikandan ka me kaap-apuan te me matig-Sura. 3-4 Ne si Hur ka kinakakayan ne anak ni Kalib te asawa rin ne si Iprata, wey ka me kabuhalan din ka migpasasindeg te Bitlihim. Ne si Hur due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Itam, si Pinuwil, wey si Isir. Ne si Itam due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hisril, si Isma, wey si Hidibas, wey due atebey ran ne egngaranan ki Hasililpuni. Si Pinuwil ka amey ni Gidur, wey si Isir ka amey ni Husa. 5 Si Asur ne amey ni Tikuwa, due daruwa ne asawa ne si Hila wey si Naara. 6 Ne seini ka anak dan ki Naara: si Ahusam, si Hipir, si Tamani, wey si Ahastari. 7 Ne seini degma ka me anak dan ki Hila: si Sirit, si Isar, wey si Itnan.

41 These were the_other descendants of Huda: Piris, Hisrun, Karmi, Hur, and Subal. 2 And Subal (was) the father of Rayas, Rayas (was) the father of Diyahat, and Diyahat (was) the father of Ahumay and of Lahad. They were the ancestors of the (ones) from_Sura. 3-4 And Hur (was) the oldest child of Kalib from his spouse Iprata, and his descendants were_the (one)_who built (LIT caused_to_stand) Bitlihim. And Hur had three male children who (were) Itam, Pinuwil, and Isir. And Itam had three male children who (were) Hisril, Isma, and Hidibas, and they had a sister named Hasililpuni. Pinuwil (was) the father of Gidur, and Isir (was) the father of Husa. 5 Asur who (was) the father of Tikuwa, had two spouses Hila and Naara. 6 And these were (particularly) their children with Naara: Ahusam, Hipir, Tamani, and Ahastari. 7 And these also were (particularly) their children with Hila: Sirit, Isar, and Itnan.

8 Si Kus ka amey ni Anub wey ni Sudiba. Ne sikandin ded degma ka kaapuan te me kabuhalan ni Aharhil ne anak ni Harum.

8 Kus (was) the father of Anub and of Sudiba. And he also was the ancestor of the descendants of Aharhil the child of Harum.

9 Ne due etew ne egngaranan ki Habis ne subla ne talahuren, du te me suled din. Si Habis[fn] ka ingngaran kandin te iney rin, su amana ne masakit ka pegpalesut kandin. 10 Ne mig-ampu si Habis te Manama te Israil ne migkahi, “Panalangini a nikeykew Manama, wey pamaluaha nu pa ka inged ne sakup ku. Dumeyi a ubag nikeykew wey ipaalihu a te karereetan.” Ne imbehey te Manama ka imbuyu din.

9 And there_was a person named Habis that was greatly respected, compared to his siblings/cousins. Habis[fn] was_what_ he _was_named by his mother, because giving_birth to_him (was) very painful. 10 And Habis prayed to the God of Israil saying, “(May) I be_blessed by_you(sg) God, and make(sg)_ the place which is under_ my _jurisdiction _be_wider. (May) I [embarrassedly] be_accompanied by_you(sg) and (may) I be_bypassed by destruction.” And God gave what_ he _requested.

11 Si Kalib ne suled ni Suwa iyan amey ni Mihir ne amey ni Istun. 12 Ne si Istun ka amey enni Bitrapa, ni Pasiya, wey ni Tihina. Ne si Tihina ka amey ni Naas. Me matig-Rika sikandan.

11 Kalib the sibling/cousin of Suwa (was) the father of Mihir the father of Istun. 12 And Istun (was) the father of Bitrapa, of Pasiya, and of Tihina. And Tihina (was) the father of Naas. They (were) from_Rika.

13 Si Kinas due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne si Utniil wey si Sirayas. Ne ka anak ni Utniil ne me lukes iyan si Hatat wey si Miyunati. 14 Ne si Miyunati ka amey ni Upra. Ne si Sirayas ka amey ni Huwab, ka nekeyimu te inged ne egngaranan te bangalug te me Pandey. Ingngaranan sika te bangalug te me Pandey tenged su me pandey ma ka nangugpe kayi.

13 Kinas had two male children Utniil and Sirayas. And the male children of Utniil (were) Hatat and Miyunati. 14 And Miyunati (was) the father of Upra. And Sirayas (was) the father of Huwab, the (one) who_made the place named valley of Carpenters. It was_named Plain of Carpenters because the (ones who) lived(pl) there (were) carpenters.

15 Ne si Kalib ne anak ni Hipuni, due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Iru, si Ila, wey si Naam. Ne si Ila ka amey ni Kinas.

15 And Kalib the child of Hipuni, had male children who (were) Iru, Ila, Naam. And Ila (was) the father of Kinas.

16 Si Hihalilil due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Sip, si Sipa, si Tiraya, wey si Asaril.

16 Hihalilil had male children who (were) Sip, Sipa, Tiraya, and Asaril.

17-18 Si Isdras due hep-at ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hitir, si Mirid, si Ipir, wey si Halun. Ne si Mirid mig-asawa ki Bitiya ne anak te Hari te Ihiptu, wey nakaanak sikandan te malitan ne iyan si Miryam, wey daruwa ne me lukes ne si Samay wey si Hisba. Ne si Hisba ka amey ni Istimuwa. Ne mig-asawa man-e si Mirid te malitan ne matig-Huda wey nakaanak sikandan te tatelu ne me lukes ne iyan si Harid ne amey ni Gidur, si Hibir ne amey ni Suku, wey si Hikutil ne amey ni Sanuwa.

17-18 Isdras (had) four male children who (were) Hitir, Mirid, Ipir, and Halun. And Mirid married Bitiya the child of the king of Ihiptu, and they bore a female who (was) Miryam, and two males who (were) Samay and Hisba. And Hisba (was) the father of Istimuwa. And Mirid also married a woman from_Huda and they bore three males who (were) Harid the father of Gidur, Hibir the father of Suku, and Hikutil the father of Sanuwa.

19 Ne mig-asawa si Hudiyas te atebey ni Naham. Ne ka sabeka te me anak dan ne lukes, iyan amey ni Kila ne kaapuan te me matig-Garmi, wey ka dangeb, amey ni Istimuwa ne kaapuan te me matig-Maaka.

19 And Hudiyas got_married with the female_sibling of Naham. And the one of their male children, is the father of Kila who is the ancestor of the (ones) from_Garmi, and the other one, (is) the father of Istimuwa who is ancestor of the (ones) from_Maaka.

20 Si Simun due hep-at ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Amnun, si Rina, si Binhanan, wey si Tilun.

20 Simun had four male children who (were) Amnun, Rina, Binhanan, and Tilun.

Si Ishi due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne si Suwit wey Binasuwit.

Ishi had two male children Suwit and Binasuwit.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Sila

The descendants of Sila

21 Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Sila ne anak ni Huda, iyan si Ir ne kaapuan te me matig-Lika, si Laada ne kaapuan te me matig-Marisa, wey te me pamilya te me talaggimu te hinabel diye te Bit-Asbis, 22 ni Hukim wey te me mahinged te Kusiba, ni Huwas wey ni Sarap ne migmandu te Muwab wey te Hasubilihim. (Ka seini ne me sinulat puun pad te tapey ne timpu.) 23 Migpamakey sikandan te Hari isip me talaggimu te me kuren, wey diye sikandan mig-ugpe te Nitaim wey Gidira.

21 The descendants of Sila the child of Huda, (were) Ir the ancestor of the (ones) from_Lika, Laada the ancestor of the (ones) from_Marisa, and of the families of makers of woven_cloth there at Bit-Asbis, 22 of Hukim and of the inhabitants of Kusiba, of Huwas and Sarap who ruled Muwab and Hasubilihim. (These writings come_from old times.) 23 They served the king as makers of pots, and they lived there_to Nitaim and Gidira.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Simyun

The descendants of Simyun

24 Ne ka me anak ni Simyun ne me lukes iyan si Nimwil, si Hamin, si Harib, si Sira, wey si Saul. 25 Ne si Saul ka amey ni Salum, si Salum ka amey ni Mabsam, wey si Mabsam ka amey ni Misma. 26 Ne si Misma ka amey ni Hamwil, si Hamwil ka amey ni Sakur, wey si Sakur ka amey ni Simii. 27 Ne si Simii due sapulu wey hen-em (16) ne anak ne me lukes wey hen-em ne malitan, piru pila-pila re ka anak te me suled din. Sikan naa ka kene ne iling kasulug ka tribu ran te kabuhalan ni Huda.

24 Then the male children of Simyun (were) Nimwil, Hamin, Harib, Sira, and Saul. 25 Then Saul was the father of Salum, Salum was the father of Mabsam, and Mabsam was the father of Misma. 26 Then Misma was the father of Hamwil, Hamwil was the father of Sakur, and Sakur was the father of Simii. 27 And Simii had sixteen (16) male children and six female, but the children of his siblings/cousins (were) just a few. That's why their family aren't as many as the descendants of Huda.

28 [xr]Ne diye nangugpe ka me kabuhalan ni Simyun te Birsiba, te Mulada, te Hasar-Suwal, 29 te Bilha, te Isim, te Tulad, 30 te Bituil, te Hurma, te Siklag, 31 te Bit-Markabut, te Hasar-Susim, te Bitbiri, wey te Sa-Arim. Me lungsud dan sika taman te peghari ni Dabid. 32 Nangugpe degma sikandan diye te lalimma ne me lungsud ne iyan ka Itam, ka Ayin, ka Rimun, ka Tukin, wey ka Asan. 33 Nangugpe man-e sikandan te langun ne bariyu ne nakalingut te sika ne me lungsud taman te Baal. Sika ka nangugpaan dan, wey due listaan dan te me kabuhalan dan.

28 [xr]And the descendants of Simyun lived(pl) there at Birsiba, in Mulada, in Hasar-Suwal, 29 in Bilha, in Isim, in Tulad, 30 in Bituil, in Hurma, in Siklag, 31 in Bit-Markabut, in Hasar-Susim, in Bitbiri, and in Sa-Arim. Those were their towns until the kinging by Dabid. 32 They also lived(pl) there in five towns which (were) Itam, Ayin, Rimun, Tukin, and Asan. 33 They also lived(pl) in all the barrios surrounding these towns as_far_as Baal. That (was) their living_places, and they have a list of their descendants.

34 Ka me pangulu te me kabuhalan dan iyan si Misubab, si Hamlik, si Husa ne anak ni Amasiyas, 35 si Huwil, si Dihu ne anak ni Husabiyas, ne anak ni Sirayas ne anak ni Asiil, 36 si Iliyunay, si Haakuba, si Hisuhayas, si Asaya, si Adiil, si Ismil, si Binayas, 37 wey si Sisa (Si Sisa anak ni Sipi ne anak ni Alun, wey si Alun anak ni Hidayas. Si Hidayas anak ni Simri ne anak ni Simaya.) 38 Ka seeye se nangngaranan, me pangulu te me pamilya ran. Ne migmasalig sikandan amana. 39 Ne nangendiye sikandan te inged te Gidur, diye te bangalug ne dapit te igsile eyew egpamitew te egkapanabtaban te me karniru ran. 40 Ne nakakita sikandan te dakel se hilamunen wey meupiya ne panabtaban. Luluahi seini wey malinawen, wey nangugpaan dengan te me kabuhalan ni Ham.

34 The leaders of their descendants (were) Misubab, Hamlik, Husa the child of Amasiyas, 35 Huwil, Dihu the child of Husabiyas, the child of Sirayas the child of Asiil, 36 Iliyunay, Haakuba, Hisuhayas, Asaya, Adiil, Ismil, Binayas, 37 and Sisa (Sisa was a child of Sipi who_was a child of Alun, and Alun was a child of Hidayas. Hidayas was a child of Simri who_was a child of Simaya.) 38 Those named, (were) leaders of their families. And they (became) very many. 39 And they went(pl) to the place of Gidur, there at the gulley there on the east to search for grazing_places for their sheep. 40 And they saw lots of plants and the grazing_places (were) good. It (was) very_wide and peaceful, and was_ also _lived_in(pl) before by the descendants of Ham.

41 Piru te timpu te peghari ni Hisikiyas te Huda, inlusuran te narawit se me ngaran ne me kabuhalan ni Simyun ka me kabuhalan ni Ham. Inlusuran dan degma ka me Miyunihanen ne nangugpe diye, wey in-amin dan sikandan pangimatayi. Ne ka me kabuhalan e ni Simyun ka nangugpe diye kuntee, su duen ma egkapanabtaban te me karniru ran diye. 42 Me lalimma ne gatus (500) ka kabuhalan ni Simyun ne miglusud diye te bubungan te Siir ne impanguluwan enni Pilatiyas, ni Naariyas, ni Ripayas, wey ni Usil ne anak ni Ishi. 43 Ne impangimatayan dan ka me Amalikanen ne nakapallahuy, wey diyad e sikandan nangugpe taman kuntee.

41 But at the time of the kinging by Hisikiyas over Huda, the descendants of Ham were_invaded by the_mentioned names that (were) the descendants of Simyun. They also invaded the Miyunihanons that live there, and they killed(pl) them all. And the descendants of Simyun (were) the (ones who) lived there now, because there_is grazing_places for their sheep. 42 The descendants of Simyun that invaded the mountain of Siir (were) five hundred (500) that were_led by Pilatiyas, by Naariyas, by Ripayas, and by Usil the child of Ishi. 43 And they killed(pl) those Amalikanons that fled, and they lived(pl) there until now.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin

The descendants of Rubin

51-2 [xr]Si Rubin ka kinakakayan ne anak ni Israil, piru tenged te inggilabetan din ka duwey te amey rin, sikan naa ka naawe ka katenged din isip kinakakayan wey ka katenged din nekeendiyad te me anak ni Husi ne suled din. Minsan nekeendiyad ka katenged ni Rubin ki Husi, si Huda mule ka neyimu ne mabantug te me kabuhalan din wey migpuun te kabuhalan din ka pangulu te langun ne tribu te Israil. 3 Seini ka me lukes ne anak ni Rubin ne kinakakayan ne anak ni Israil: si Hanuk, si Palu, si Hisrun, wey si Karmi.

51-2 [xr]Rubin was the oldest child of Israil, but because he messed_sexually with one of the junior_wives of his father, therefore his right as oldest child removed and his right went to the children of Husi that his brother. Even_though Rubin's right as oldest went_there to Husi, Huda on_the_contrary became great(er) than his siblings and the leader of all the tribes of Israil came_from his descendant(s). 3 These were the male children of Rubin the oldest child of Israil: Hanuk, Palu, Hisrun, and Karmi.

4-6 [xr]Seini ka me kabuhalan ni Huwil: si Simaya, si Gug, si Simii, si Mika, si Riha, si Baal, wey si Biira. Si Biira ka pangulu te me kabuhalan ni Rubin te timpu ne impandakep wey impanguyan sikandan ni Tiglatpilisir ne Hari te Asirya.

4-6 [xr]These were the descendants of Huwil: Simaya, Gug, Simii, Mika, Riha, Baal, and Biira. Biira was the head/leader of the descendants of Rubin at the time that they were_captured and carried_away by Tiglatpilisir the king of Asirya.

7 Seini ka me karumaan ni Rubin ne nalista diye te listaan te me kabuhalan dan: si Hiil ka pangulu wey si Sakariyas, 8 wey si Bila ne anak ni Asas. Si Asas anak ni Sima wey si Sima anak ni Huwil. Mig-ugpe sikandan puun te Aruwir peendiye te Nibu taman te Baal-Miyun. 9 Ne tenged te amane e ne masulug ka me ayam dan diye te Gilyad, neempet dan te eg-ugpe ka igsile ne dapit te eletanan te disirtu wey te Weyig ne Iyupratis.

7 These (are) the relatives of Rubin that were_listed there in the list of their descendants: Hiil the leader and Sakariyas, 8 and Bila child of Asas. Asas (was) the child of Sima and Sima (was) the child of Huwil. They lived from Aruwir towards Nibu as_far_as Baal-Miyun. 9 And since their domestic_animals there in Gilyad (were) very many, they spread_ to_live _over the east facing the boundary of the desert and the River Iyupratis.

10 Te timpu ni Hari Saul, inlusuran dan ka me kabuhalan ni Hagar wey natalu ran iya sikandan. Ne sikandan e ka nangugpe te me ugpaan te me kabuhalanan ni Hagar ne diye te igsile ne dapit te Gilyad.

10 At the time of King Saul, they invaded the descendants of Hargar and they (Hargarnons) were_defeated indeed. And they (were) the (ones) living(pl) in the living_place of the Hargarnons there east side of Gilyad.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Gad

The descendants of Gad

11 Ne diye nangugpe ka me kabuhalan ni Gad te tane te Basan ne marani te nangugpaan te kabuhalan ni Rubin taman te Salika. 12 Ne si Huwil ka pangulu ran, ne si Sapan ka igkarangeb, wey iyan nakasinundul si Hanay wey si Sapat. 13 Ka me karumaan dan ne me pangulu te pitu ne pamilya iyan si Maykil, si Misulam, si Siyiba, si Huray, si Hakan, si Siya, wey si Ibir. 14 Sikandan ka me kabuhalan ni Abihail, ne anak ni Huri, ne anak ni Haruwa, ne anak ni Gilyad, ne anak ni Maykil, ne anak ni Hisisay, ne anak ni Hadu, ne anak ni Bus. 15 Ne iyan pangulu te me pamilya ran si Ahi ne anak ni Adbiil, ne anak ni Guni. 16 Ne diye sikandan nangugpe te Gilyad, te Basan wey te me lungsud diye, wey te intiru ne panabtaban ne diye te Sarun. 17 Nenalista sikandan langun te listaan te me kabuhalan te timpu ne iyan Hari te Huda si Hutam, wey iyan Hari te Israil si Hirubuwam.

11 And the descendants of Gad lived(pl) there in the land of Basan near the living_places of the descendants of Rubin as_far_as Salika. 12 And Huwil (was) their leader, and Sapan (was) the next, and Hanay and Sapat followed. 13 Their relatives the leaders of seven families (were) Maykil, Misulam, Siyiba, Huray, Hakan, Siya, and Ibir. 14 They (were) the descendants of Abihail, child of Huri, child of Haruwa, child of Gilyad, child of Maykil, child of Hisisay, child of Hadu, child of Bus. 15 And Ahi child of Adbiil, child of Guni (was) leader of their family. 16 And they lived(pl) there in Gilyad, in Basan and the towns there, and in entire grazing_places there in Sarun. 17 They all were_listed(pl) in the list of the descendants at the time that Hutam (was) king of Huda, and Hirubuwam (was) king of Israil.

Ka me sundalu te me kabuhalan ne diye te igsile

The soldiers of the descendants there in the east

18 Due hep-at ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu wey pitu ne gatus wey hen-em ne pulu (44,760) ne amana ne mabbulut ne me sundalu te kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis. Amana sikandan nabbasbas te gira, wey mangngateu sikandan ne eggamit te me kalasag, kampilan, wey pane. 19 Migbubunu kandan ka me kabuhalan ni Hagar, ni Hitur, ni Napis, wey ni Nubab. 20 Ne ka mabbulut ne me sundalu te kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey te katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis, mig-ampu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama wey intabak din ka peg-ampu dan su migsalig ma sikandan kandin. Sikan naa ka natalu ran ka me kabuhalan ni Hagar wey ka me duma ran. 21 Ne naahew ran puun te me kabuhalan ni Hagar ka lalimma ne pulu ne libu (50,000) ne kamil, daruwa ne pulu ne gatus wey lalimma ne libu (250,000) ne karniru, wey daruwa ne libu (2,000) ne asnu. Ne nakarakep sikandan te sabeka ne gatus ne libu (100,000) ne me etew. 22 Masulug ka migpatey ne me kabuhalan ni Hagar te pegbubunu dan su ka Manama ka migkuntere kandan. Ne iyan e nangugpe te tane dan ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey ni Manasis, taman te naddakep wey nanguyan e sikandan te me matig-Asirya.

18 There_were forty four thousand seven hundred sixty (44,760) very fierce soldiers of the descendant(s) of Rubin, of Gad, and the half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) the descendants of Manasis. They greatly practised(pl) in war, and they were skilled(pl) in using shields, swords, and bows. 19 The descendants of Hagar, of Hitur, of Napis, and of Nubab fought_against them. 20 And the fierce(pl) soldiers of the descendant(s) of Rubin, of Gad, and the half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) the descendants of Manasis, prayed there to the Lord God and he answered their praying because they trusted him. That's why they defeated the descendants of Hagar and their companions. 21 And they snatched fifty thousand (50,000) camels, two hundred and fifty thousand (250,000) sheep, and two thousand (2,000) donkeys. And they captured one hundred thousand (100,000) people. 22 Many descendants of Hagar died(pl) in their fighting because God was_against them. And the descendants of Rubin, of Gad, and of Manasis lived(pl) in their land, until they were_captured(pl) and taken_away(pl) by the (ones) from_Asirya.

Ka me pangulu te kabuhalan ni Manasis

The leaders of the descendant(s) of Manasis

23 Ne diye nangugpe te Basan taman te Baal-Hirmun, Sinir, wey te bubungan te Hirmun ka katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis. 23 And the half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) the descendants of Manasis lived(pl) there in Basan as_far_as Baal-Hirmun, Sinir, and the mountain of Hirmun. Ka pegkarakep te me kabuhalan ne diye te igsile

The capturing of the descendants there in the east

25 Piru ware sikandan migmatinumanen te Manama te me kabuybuyahan dan, su nasi mule sikandan migsimba te me diyus-diyus te keet-etawan te seeye ne tane ne indereetan te Manama. 26 [xra][xrb][xrc]Sikan naa ka imbagget te Manama te Israil si Hari Pul (ne iyan si Tiglatpilisir ne Hari te Asirya) eyew eglusud kandan. Ne impandakep ni Pul ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey ka katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis, wey impanguyan din e diye te Hala, Habur, Hara, wey diye te Weyig te Gusan, wey diye ded sikandan taman kuntee.

25 But they weren't faithful to the God of their elders, because instead on_the_contrary they worshiped the false_gods of the people of that land that were_destroyed by God. 26 [xra][xrb][xrc]That's why the God of Israil encouraged King Pul (who (was) Tiglatpilisir king of Asirya) in_order to_invade them. And Pul were_captured the descendants of Rubin, of Gad, and the half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) the descendants of Manasis, and taken_away(pl) by_him there to Hala, Habur, Hara, and there to the River Gusan, and they are still there until now/today.

4 And Iliyasar was the father of Pinihas, and Pinihas was the father of Abisuwa. 5 And Abisuwa was the father of Buki, and Buki was the father of Usi. 6 And Usi was the father of Sirayas, and Sirayas was the father of Mirayut. 7 And Mirayut was the father of Amariyas, and Amariyas was the father of Ahitub. 8 And Ahitub was the father of Saduk, and Saduk was the father of Ahimaas. 9 And Ahimaas was the father of Asariyas, and Asariyas was the father of Diyuhanan. 10 And Diyuhanan was the father of Asariyas. Inggimu ran ka me katungdanan dan sumale te nabatasan dan.

They did their duties according to their customs.

39 Ne ka an-anayan ne talagbulig ni Himan iyan si Asap ne karumaan din. Si Asap anak ni Birikiyas, wey si Birikiyas anak ni Simiya. 40 Ne si Simiya anak ni Maykil, wey si Maykil anak ni Baasiyas, wey si Baasiyas anak ni Malkiyas. 41 Ne si Malkiyas anak ni Itni, wey si Itni anak ni Sira, wey si Sira anak ni Adayas. 42 Ne si Adayas anak ni Itan, wey si Itan anak ni Sima, wey si Sima anak ni Simii. 43 Ne si Simii anak ni Diyahat, wey si Diyahat anak ni Girsun, wey si Girsun anak ni Libi.

39 And the first helper of Himan (was) Asap his relative. Asap (was) the child of Birikiyas, and Birikiyas (was) the child of Simiya. 40 And Simiya (was) the child of Maykil, and Maykil (was) the child of Baasiyas, and Baasiyas (was) the child of Malkiyas. 41 And Malkiyas (was) the child of Itni, and Itni (was) the child of Sira, and Sira (was) the child of Adayas. 42 And Adayas (was) the child of Itan, and Itan (was) the child of Sima, and Sima (was) the child of Simii. 43 And Simii (was) the child of Diyahat, and Diyahat (was) the child of Girsun, and Girsun (was) the child of Libi.

44 Ka igkarangeb ne talagbulig ni Himan iyan si Itan ne migpuun te karumaan ni Mirari: si Itan anak ni Kisi, wey si Kisi anak ni Abdi, wey si Abdi anak ni Maluk. 45 Ne si Maluk anak ni Hasabiyas, wey si Hasabiyas anak ni Amasiyas, wey si Amasiyas anak ni Hilkiyas. 46 Ne si Hilkiyas anak ni Amsi, wey si Amsi anak ni Bani, wey si Bani anak ni Simir. 47 Ne si Simir anak ni Mali, wey si Mali anak ni Musi, wey si Musi anak ni Mirari, wey si Mirari anak ni Libi.

44 The second helper of Himan (was) Itan from the descendants of Mirari: Itan (was) the child of Kisi, and Kisi (was) the child of Abdi, and Abdi (was) the child of Maluk. 45 And Maluk (was) the child of Hasabiyas, and Hasabiyas (was) the child of Amasiyas, and Amasiyas (was) the child of Hilkiyas. 46 And Hilkiyas (was) the child of Amsi, and Amsi (was) the child of Bani, and Bani (was) the child of Simir. 47 And Simir (was) the child of Mali, and Mali (was) the child of Musi, and Musi (was) the child of Mirari, and Mirari (was) the child of Libi.

48 Ne impiyal diye te karumaan te me Libita ka duma pad ne me himu diye te ugpaan te Manama ne iyan ka Matulus ne Balungbalung ne In-alad. 49 Piru si Aarun wey ka me kabuhalan din ka egpanubad te igpanubad ne egtutungen wey te insinsu. Sikandan man-e ka eggimu te langun ne eggimuwen diye te Subla ne Matulus ne Sinabeng wey ka egpalangesa eyew iglinis te sale te Israil. Inggimu ran seeye sumale te langun ne insuhu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Manama. 50 Seini ka me kabuhalan ni Aarun: si Ilisar, si Pinihas, si Abisuwa, 51 si Buki, si Usi, si Sarayas, 52 si Mirayut, si Amariyas, si Ahitub, 53 si Saduk, wey si Ahimaas.

48 And the other works in the living_place of God which (was) the Holy Tent that's Fenced were_entrusted to the relatives of the Libitas. 49 But Aarun and his descendants (were) the (ones who) sacrificed burnt sacrifices and incense. They also (were) the (ones who) did all to_be_done there in the Very Holy Room and the (ones who) drew_blood in_order to_clean the sin of Israil. They did that according to all that was_commanded by Muwisis the servant of God. 50 These (were) the descendants of Aarun: Ilisar, Pinihas, Abisuwa, 51 Buki, Usi, Sarayas, 52 Mirayut, Amariyas, Ahitub, 53 Saduk, and Ahimaas.

Ka me inged ne in-ugpaan te me Libita

The places lived_in by the Libitas

54 Seini ka me inged ne imbehey te pamilya ni Kuhat diye te me kabuhalan ni Aarun. Sikandan ka an-anayan ne nabehayan te tane pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut. 55 Iyan imbehey kandan ka Hibrun ne sakup te Huda wey ka nakalingut ne me panabtaban kayi. 56 Piru imbehey ki Kalib ne anak ni Hipuni ka me kamet wey ka me bariyu ne sakup te siyudad. 57 Ne iyan dan imbehey te me kabuhalan ni Aarun ka me siyudad ne aputanan[fn] ne iyan ka Hibrun, ka Libna, wey ka me panabtaban kayi, ka Hatir, ka Istimuwa, wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 58 ka Hilis wey ka me panabtaban kayi, ka Dibir wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 59 ka Asan wey ka me panabtaban kayi, ka Bit-Simis wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 60 Ne puun te tane te kabuhalan ni Binhamin, imbehey kandan ka Gibyun, ka Alamit wey ka Anatut, wey ka me panabtaban kayi. Nabehayan te sapulu wey tatelu (13) ne me siyudad ka me kabuhalan ni Kuhat. 61 Ne nabehayan ka duma ne kabuhalan ni Kuhat te sapulu ne me lungsud ne naalam pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut puun te katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis.

54 These (were) the places given by the family of Kuhat there to the descendants of Aarun. They (were) the first to_be_given land by_means of drawing_lots. 55 What_was_given to_them (was) Hibrun under_the_jurisdiction of Huda and the surrounding grazing_places here. 56 But the fields and the barrios under_the_jurisdiction of the city were_given to Kalib the son of Hipuni. 57 And what_ they _gave to the descendants of Aarun (were) the cities that's fleeing_places[fn] which (were) Hibrun, Libna, and the grazing_places here, Hatir, Istimuwa, and the grazing_places here, 58 Hilis and the grazing_places here, Dibir and the grazing_places here, 59 Asan and the grazing_places here, Bit-Simis and the grazing_places here. 60 And from the land of the descendant(s) of Binhamin, they were_given Gibyun, Alamit and Anatut, including the grazing_places here. The family of Kuhat was_given thirteen (13) cities. 61 And the other descendants of Kuhat were_given ten towns that were_chosen by_means of drawing_lots from half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) the descendants of Manasis.

62 Ne nabehayan ka me kabuhalan ni Girsun te sapulu wey tatelu (13) ne me lungsud ne naalam pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut puun te me kabuhalan ni Isakar, ni Asir, ni Naptali, wey ni Manasis. 63 Ne nabehayan ka me kabuhalan ni Mirari te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne me lungsud puun te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey ni Sabulun. 64 Purisu imbehey te keet-etawan te Israil diye te me Libita ka sika ne me lungsud wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 65 Imbehey te me matig-Israil diye te me Libita, pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, ka nangaranan ne me lungsud puun te kabuhalan ni Huda, ni Simyun, wey ni Binhamin. 66 Ne ka duma ne pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Kuhat, impamehayan degma te me lungsud puun te kabuhalan ni Ipraim. 67 Imbehey kandan seini ne me inged lagkes ka nakalingut ne me panabtaban kayi, ka Sikim ne aputanan ne siyudad ne diye te me bubungan te Ipraim, ka Gisir, 68 ka Hukmi-Am, ka Bit-Hurun wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 69 ka Ayalun wey ka me panabtaban kayi, ka Gat-Rimun wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 70 Ka duma pad ne pamilya ni Kuhat imbehayan te duma ran ne me matig-Israil te me lungsud puun te katenge ne kabuhalan ni Manasis. Ka imbehey kandan iyan ka Anir wey ka Bilim, lagkes e ka me panabtaban kayi.

62 And the descendants of Girsun were_given thirteen (13) towns that were_chosen by drawing_lots from the descendants of Isakar, of Asir, of Naptali, and of Manasis. 63 And the descendants of Mirari were_given twelve (12) towns from the descendants of Rubin, of Gad, and of Sabulun. 64 Therefore those towns and the grazing_places here were_given to the Libitas by the people of Israil. 65 The named towns from the descendant(s) of Huda, of Simyun, and of Binhamin, were_given to the Libitas by the (ones) from_Israil, by_means of drawing_lots. 66 And the other family(s) of the descendants of Kuhat, were_ also _given towns from the descendants of Ipraim. 67 They were_given these places including the surrounding grazing_places here, Sikim the city that's a fleeing_place there in the mountains of Ipraim, Gisir, 68 Hukmi-Am, Bit-Hurun and the grazing_places here, 69 Ayalun and the grazing_places here, Gat-Rimun and the grazing_places here. 70 The yet other family(s) of Kuhat were_given of their from_Israil of their companions of towns from the half descendant(s) of Manasis. What_was_given to_them (was) Anir and Bilim, including the grazing_places here.

71 Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Hirsun, imbehayan te katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis te seini ne me lungsud: ka Gulan ne sakup te Basan wey ka me panabtaban kayi, wey ka Astarut wey ka me panabtaban kayi.

71 And the descendants of Hirsun, were_given these towns by the half descendant(s) of Manasis: Gulan under_the_jurisdiction of Basan and (including) the grazing_places here, and Astarut and (including) the grazing_places here.

72 Ne imbehayan degma sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Isakar te seini ne me lungsud: ka Kadis lagkes ka me panabtaban kayi, ka Dibarat lagkes ka me panabtaban kayi, 73 ka Ramut lagkes ka me panabtaban kayi, wey ka Anim lagkes ka me panabtaban kayi. 74 Ne imbehayan degma sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Asir te seini ne me lungsud: ka Masal wey ka me panabtaban kayi, ka Abdun wey ka intiru ne panabtaban kayi, 75 ka Hukuk, wey ka me panabtaban kayi, ka Rihub wey ka me panabtaban kayi.

72 And they were_ also _given these towns by the descendants of Isakar: Kadis including the grazing_places here, Dibarat including the grazing_places here, 73 Ramut including the grazing_places here, and Anim including the grazing_places here. 74 And they were_ also _given these towns by the descendants of Asir: Masal and the grazing_places here, Abdun and the grazing_places here, 75 Hukuk, and the grazing_places here, Rihub and the grazing_places here.

76 Ne imbehayan degma sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Naptali te seini ne me lungsud: ka Kadis ne sakup te Galiliya wey me panabtaban kayi, ka Hamun wey ka Kiryatayim wey me panabtaban kayi.

76 And they were_ also _given these towns by the descendants of Naptali: Kadis under_the_jurisdiction of Galiliya and the (including) the grazing_places here, Hamun and Kiryatayim and (including) the grazing_places here.

77 Ne imbehayan degma te me kabuhalan ni Sabulun ka nasame ne me kabuhalan ni Mirari te seini ne me lungsud: ka Rimunu wey me panabtaban kayi, ka Tabur wey me panabtaban kayi.

77 And the remainder of the descendants of Mirari were_given these towns by the descendant(s) of Sabulun: Rimunu and the grazing_places here, and Tabur and the grazing_places here.

78 Ne imbehayan degma sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Rubin te seini ne me lungsud: ka tane te Hurdan dapit te igsile, wey ka Bisir ne diye te disirtu ne talipag te Hiriku wey me panabtaban kayi, ka Hasa wey me panabtaban kayi, 79 ka Kidimut wey me panabtaban kayi, ka Mipaat wey me panabtaban kayi.

78 And they were_ also _given these towns by the descendants of Rubin: land of Hurdan facing east, and of Bisir there in the desert on_the_opposite_bank from Hiriku and the grazing_places here, Hasa and the grazing_places here, 79 Kidimut and the grazing_places here, Mipaat and the grazing_places here.

80 Ne imbehayan sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Gad te seini ne me lungsud: ka Ramut ne sakup te Gilyad wey ka me panabtaban kayi, Mahanaim wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 81 ka Hisbun wey ka me panabtaban kayi, wey ka Hasir wey ka me panabtaban kayi.

80 And they were_given these towns by the descendant(s) of Gad: Ramut under_the_jurisdiction of Gilyad and the grazing_places here, Mahanaim and the grazing_places here, 81 Hisbun and the grazing_places here, and Hasir and the grazing_places here.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Isakar

The descendants of Isacar

71 Ne si Isakar due hep-at ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Tula, si Puwa, si Hasub, wey si Simrun. 2 Ne si Tula due hen-em ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Usi, si Rapayas, si Hiril, si Hamay, si Ibsam, wey si Simwil; me pangulu sikandan te me pamilya ran. Ne migginguma te daruwa ne pulu wey daruwa ne libu, wey hen-em ne gatus (22,600) ka kabuhalan ni Tula ne me bahani te timpu te peghari ni Dabid.

71 And Isakar had four male children who were (particularly) Tula, Puwa, Hasub, and Simrun. 2 And Tula had six male children who were (particularly) Usi, Rapayas, Hiril, Hamay, Ibsam, and Simwil; they were heads/leaders of their families. And the descendants of Tula came_to twenty two thousand, and six hundred (22,600) who were warriors at the time of kinging by Dabid.

3 Ne si Usi due sabeka ne anak ne lukes ne iyan si Israhiyas. Ne si Israhiyas due hep-at ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Maykil, si Ubadiya, si Huwil, wey si Isiyas; pangulu sikandan langun se lalimma te me pamilya ran. 4 Ne migginguma te tatelu ne pulu wey hen-em ne libu (36,000) ka kabuhalan dan ne me sundalu su masulug ma ka me asawa ran wey me anak dan ne me lukes.

3 And Usi had one male child who was Israhiyas. And Israhiyas had four male children who were Maykil, Ubadiya, Huwil, and Isiyas; all five of them (were) leaders of their families. 4 And they came_to thirty-six thousand (36,000) their soldiers descendant because their wives (were) many and their male children.

5 Ne walu ne pulu wey pitu ne libu (87,000) ka kasuluhan te me bahani ne egpuun te langun ne kabuhalan ni Isakar wey nallista sikandan langun te listaan te me kabuhalan dan.

5 And the count of warriors from all the descendants of Isakar (were) eighty-seven thousand (87,000) and they all were_listed in the list of their descendants.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin

The descendants of Binhamin

6 Ne si Binhamin due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Bila, si Bikur, wey si Hidiyail. 7 Ne si Bila due lalimma ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Isbun, si Usi, si Usil, si Hirimut, wey si Iri; me pangulu sikandan te me pamilya ran. Ne migginguma te daruwa ne pulu wey daruwa ne libu wey tatelu ne pulu wey hep-at (22,034) ka me kabuhalan dan ne me bahani.

6 And Binhamin had three male children who were Bila, Bikur, and Hidiyail. 7 And Bila had five male children who were Isbun, Usi, Usil, Hirimut, and Iri; they (were) leaders of their families. And their descendants that (were) warriors came_to twenty two thousand and thirty four (22,034).

8 Ne si Bikur due siyam ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Samira, si Huwas, si Ilisir, si Iliyunay, si Umri, si Hirimut, si Abiyas, si Anatut, wey si Almat. 9 Seeye ka me pangulu te pamilya ran wey me bahani ne nalista te listaan te me kabuhalan dan. Migginguma sikandan te daruwa ne pulu ne libu wey daruwa ne gatus (20,200).

8 And Bikur had nine male children who were Samira, Huwas, Ilisir, Iliyunay, Umri, Hirimut, Abiyas, Anatut, and Almat. 9 Those (were) the leaders of their families and the warriors that were_listed in the list of their descendants. They came_to twenty thousand and two hundred (20,200).

10 Ne si Hidiyail due sabeka ne anak ne lukes ne iyan si Bilhan. Ne si Bilhan due pitu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hiyus, si Binhamin, si Ihud, si Kanana, si Sitan, si Tarsis, wey si Ahisahar. 11 Me anak sikandan langun ni Hadil. Ne ka nalista te listaan te me kabuhalan dan, migginguma te sapulu wey pitu ne libu wey daruwa ne gatus (17,200) ne me pangulu te me kabuhalan dan wey me bahani ne eleg e ne egmambubunu. 12 Ne ka me anak ni Ir ne me lukes iyan si Supim wey si Hupim. Ne ka anak ni Ahir iyan si Husim.

10 And Hidiyail had one male child who was Bilhan. And Bilhan had seven male children who were Hiyus, Binhamin, Ihud, Kanana, Sitan, Tarsis, and Ahisahar. 11 They all (were) children of Hadil. And the (ones) listed in the list of their descendants, came_to seventeen thousand and two hundred (17,200) leaders of their descendants and warriors that (were) capable to fight(pl). 12 And the male children of Ir were Supim and Hupim. And the child of Ahir was Husim.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Naptali

The descendants of Naptali

13 Ne si Naptali due hep-at ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hasil, si Guni, si Hisir, wey si Siyalum. Me kabuhalan sikandan langun ni Bilha ne duwey ni Hakub.

13 And Naptali had four male children who were Hasil, Guni, Hisir, and Siyalum. They all (were) descendants of Bilha the junior_wife of Hakub.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis

The descendants of Manasis

14 Ne si Manasis due me lukes ne anak din te duwey rin ne matig-Aramiya ne ensi Asril wey si Makir. Ne si Makir iyan amey ni Gilyad. 15 Ne migpangasawa si Makir te atebey enni Hupim wey ni Supim ne egngaranan ki Maaka. Ne ka ngaran te lein ne anak ni Manasis iyan si Silupihad ne due me anak ne me malitan. 16 Ne si Maaka ne asawa ni Makir nakaanak ki Piris wey ki Siris. Ne si Piris due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Ulam wey si Rakim. 17 Ne si Ulam due anak ne lukes ne iyan si Bidan. Me kabuhalan sikandan langun ni Gilyad ne anak ni Makir ne anak ni Manasis.

14 And Manasis had male children by his junior_wife from_Aramiya who were Asril and Makir. And Makir was the father of Gilyad. 15 And Makir married the sister of Hupim and of Supim that was_named Maaka. And the name of the other child of Manasis was Silupihad that had female children. 16 And Maaka the spouse of Makir gave_birth to Piris and Siris. And Piris had two male children that were Ulam and Rakim. 17 And Ulam had a male child that was Bidan. They all (were) descendants of Gilyad the child of Makir the child of Manasis.

18 Ne si Hamulikit ne atebey ni Gilyad, due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Isud, si Abisir, wey si Mala.

18 And Hamulikit the sister of Gilyad, had three male children that were Isud, Abisir, and Mala.

19 Ne si Simida, ka lein pad man-e ne kabuhalan ni Manasis, due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Ahiyan, si Siki, si Liki, wey si Aniyam.

19 And Simida, the other descendant of Manasis, had male children that were Ahiyan, Siki, Liki, and Aniyam.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Ipraim

The descendants of Ipraim

20 Seini ka me ngaran te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim:

20 These (are) the names of the descendants of Ipraim:

Si Ipraim due anak ne si Sutala, ne si Sutala due anak ne si Barid, ne si Barid due anak ne si Tahat, ne si Tahat due anak ne si Iliyada, ne si Iliyada due anak ne si Tahat,21 ne si Tahat due anak ne si Sabad, si Sutala, si Isir, wey si Iliyad ne impangimatayan te mahinged te Gat su egpanakew perem te baka. 22 Ne naluhey ne miglungku si Ipraim tenged te pegpatey ran wey migleuy kandin ka me karumaan din eyew egliwang kandin. 23 Ne miggulid e man-e sikandin te asawa rin. Ne nataman, naberes e ka asawa rin wey mig-anak e man-e te lukes. Ne ingngaranan ni Ipraim ki Biriyas[fn] ka bate tenged te karereetan ne neyitabu te pamilya rin.

Ipraim had a child Sutala, and Sutala had a child Barid, and Barid had a child Tahat, and Tahat had a child Iliyada, and Iliyada had a child Tahat,21 and Tahat had child(ren) Sabad, Sutala, Isir, and Iliyad that were_killed(pl) by the local_inhabitants of Gat because (they) tried to_steal(pl) cow(s). 22 And Ipraim mourned for a long_time due to their death and his relatives visited him in_order to_comfort him. 23 And he again lay_with his spouse. And then, his spouse was pregnant and gave_birth again to a male. And the baby was_named Biriyas[fn] by Ipraim due to the destruction that happened to his family.

24 Ne due anak din ne malitan ne egngaranan ki Siira ne iyan migpasasindeg te diralem wey dibabew ne me lungsud te Bit-Hurun wey Usin-Sira.

24 And he had a female child named Siira that built up (LIT caused_to_stand) the lower and upper towns of Bit-Hurun and Usin-Sira.

25 Ne duen pad man-e lein ne anak ni Ipraim ne egngaranan ki Rapa. Ne si Rapa ka amey ni Risip, wey si Risip ka amey ni Tila, wey si Tila ka amey ni Tahan. 26 Ne si Tahan ka amey ni Ladan, wey si Ladan ka amey ni Amihud, wey si Amihud ka amey ni Ilisama. 27 Ne si Ilisama ka amey ni Nun, wey si Nun ka amey ni Huswi.

25 And there_was still another child of Ipraim named Rapa. And Rapa (was) the father of Risip, and Risip (was) the father of Tila, and Tila (was) the father of Tahan. 26 And Tahan (was) the father of Ladan, and Ladan (was) the father of Amihud, and Amihud (was) the father of Ilisama. 27 And Ilisama (was) the father of Nun, and Nun (was) the father of Huswi.

28 Ne ka tane wey ugpaanan dan iyan ka Bitil wey ka me bariyu ne nakalingut kayi; ka Naaran peendiye te igsile, ka Gisir wey ka me bariyu kayi peendiye te iglineb, ka Sikim wey ka me lungsud kayi taman diye te Aya wey te me lungsud kayi.

28 And their land and living_places were Bitil and the barrios that surround here; Naaran going_towards the east, Gisir and the barrios here going_towards the west, Sikim and the towns here as_far_as Aya and the towns here.

29 Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis iyan ka nakakamuney te Bitsan, te Tanak, te Migidu, te Dur, wey te me bariyu ne nakalingut kayi.

29 And the descendants of Manasis was owners of Bitsan, of Tanak, of Migidu, of Dur, and of the barrios that surround here.

Ne nangugpe te seini ne me lungsud ka me kabuhalan ni Husi ne anak ni Hakub.[fn]

And the descendants of Husi who was a child of Hakub[fn] lived(pl) in these towns.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Asir

The descendants of Asir

30 Ne si Asir due hep-at ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Imna, si Isba, si Isbi, wey si Biriyas. Ne due atebey ran ne egngaranan ki Sira.

30 And Asir had four male children that were Imma, Isba, Isbi, and Biriyas. And there_was their sister named Sira.

31 Ne si Biriyas due daruwa ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Hibir wey si Malkil. Ne si Malkil ka amey ni Barsahit.

31 And Biriyas had two male children that were Hibir and Malkil. And Malkil (was) the father of Barsahit.

32 Ne si Hibir ka amey ni Haplit, ni Sumir, wey ni Hutam. Ne due atebey ran ne egngaranan ki Suwa. 33 Ne si Haplit due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Pasak, si Bimhal, wey si Asbat.

32 And Hibir (was) the father of Haplit, of Sumir, and of Hutam. And there_was their sister named Suwa. 33 And Haplit had sons that were Pasak, Bimhal, and Asbat.

34 Ne si Sumir ne suled ni Haplit, due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Ruga, si Dihuba, wey si Aram.

34 And Sumir the sibling/cousin of Haplit, had male children who were Ruga, Dihuba, and Aram.

35 Ne si Hutam[fn] ne suled ni Sumir, due anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Supa, si Imna, si Silis, wey si Amal.

35 And Hutam[fn] the sibling/cousin of Sumir, had male children who were Supa, Imna, Silis, and Amal.

36 Ne si Supa due me anak ne lukes ne iyan si Suwa, si Harnapir, si Suwal, si Biri, si Imra, 37 si Bisir, si Hud, si Sama, si Silsa, si Itran, wey si Biira.

36 And Supa had male children who were Suwa, Harnapir, Suwal, Biri, Imra, 37 Bisir, Hud, Sama, Silsa, Itran, and Biira.

38 Ne si Hitir due me anak ne lukes ne iyan si Hipuni, Pispa, wey si Ara. 39 Ne si Ula due me anak ne lukes ne iyan si Ara, si Hanil, wey si Risya.

38 And Hitir had male children who were Hipuni, Pispa, and Ara. 39 And Ula had male children who were Ara, Hanil, and Risya.

40 Me kabuhalan sikandan langun ni Asir wey me pangulu te me pamilya ran. Me bahani sikandan wey inila ne me pangulu. Ne due daruwa ne pulu wey hen-em ne libu (26,000) ne me sundalu ran ne nalista te listaan te me kabuhalan dan.

40 They (were) all descendants of Asir and leaders of their families. They (were) warriors and recognized leaders. And they had twenty six thousand (26,000) soldiers that were_listed in the list of their descendants.

Ka duma pad ne kabuhalan ni Binhamin

The other descendants of Binhamin

81 Seini ka anak ni Binhamin ne me lukes puun te panganey taman te kinahariyan: si Bila, si Asbil, si Ahara, 2 si Nuha, wey si Rapa.

81 These (were) the male children of Binhamin from the eldest until the youngest: Bila, Asbil, Ahara, 2 Nuha, and Rapa.

3 Ne ka anak ni Bila ne me lukes iyan si Adar, si Gira, si Abihud, 4 si Abisuwa, si Naaman, si Ahuwa, 5 si Gira, si Sipupan, wey si Huram.

3 And the male children of Bila were Adar, Gira, Abihud, 4 Abisuwa, Naaman, Ahuwa, 5 Gira, Sipupan, and Huram.

6 Ne seini ka me anak ni Ihud ne me lukes wey me pangulu te me pamilya ne nangugpe diye te Giba ne naddakep wey nanguyan e diye te Manahat: 7 si Naaman, si Ahiyas, wey si Higlam ne egngaranan ded ki Gira. Ne iyan dan pangulu si Gira ne amey ni Usa wey ni Ahihud.

6 And these (were) the male children of Ihud and the leaders of families that live there at Giba that were_captured(pl) and taken(pl) there to Manahat: 7 Naaman, Ahiyas, and Higlam also named Gira. And Gira the father of Usa and of Ahihud (was) their leader.

8 Ne in-engkeran e ni Saharayim ka daruwa ne asawa rin ne si Husim wey si Bara. Ne nataman te diyad e sikandin mig-ugpe te nasud te Muwab, 9 nakaasawe e man-e sikandin ki Hudis wey nakaanak sikandan te pitu ne me lukes ne iyan si Hubab, si Sibiya, si Misa, si Malkam, 10 si Hiyus, si Sikiya, wey si Marma. Neneyimu sikandan ne me pangulu te me pamilya ran.

8 And Saharayim left his two spouses Husim and Bara. And then when he lived in the nation of Muwab, 9 he married again to Hudis and they gave_birth to seven males that were Hubab, Sibiya, Misa, Malkam, 10 Hiyus, Sikiya, and Marma. They became(pl) leaders of their families.

11 Ne due man-e daruwa ne anak din ne me lukes ki Husim ne iyan si Abitub wey si Ilpaal.

11 And there_were also two male children of Husim that were Abitub and Ilpaal.

12 Ne si Ilpaal due tatelu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Ibir, si Misaam, wey si Simid. Ne si Simid ka migpasasindeg te me lungsud te Unu wey Lud wey te me bariyu[fn] ne nakalingut kayi.

12 And Ilpaal had three male children who were Ibir, Misaam, and Simid. And Simid built (LIT caused_to_stand) the towns of Unu and Lud and the barrios[fn] that surround them (LIT here).

Ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin diye te Gat wey Ayalun

The descendants of Binhamin there at Gat and Ayalun

13 Si Biriyas wey si Sima ka me pangulu te me pamilya diye te Ayalun wey immandeldel ran ka me matig-Gat. 14 Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Biriyas iyan si Ahiyu, si Siyasak, si Hirimut, 15 si Sibadiyas, si Arad, si Idir, 16 si Maykil, si Ispa, wey si Huha.

13 Biriyas and Sima (were) the leaders of families there at Ayalun and they drove_out(pl) the (ones) from_Gat. 14 And the descendants of Biriyas (were) Ahiyu, Siyasak, Hirimut, 15 Sibadiyas, Arad, Idir, 16 Maykil, Ispa, and Huha.

Ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin diye te Hirusalim

The descendants of Binhamin there in Hirusalim
