He didn't obey the warnings of the Lord God. Instead he questioned/inquire(pl) (a) fortune_teller, 14 and not there to the Lord God. Therefore he was_caused to be_killed by the Lord God and gave his kingdom there to Dabid the child of Hisi.

Ka pegkeyimu ni Dabid ne Hari

The becoming king by Dabid

(2 Sam 5:1‑10)

(2 Sam 5:1‑10)

111 Ne miggendiye ki Dabid diye te Hibrun ka langun ne matig-Israil wey migkahi, “Amana key pad iya nikeykew ne karumaan. 2 Te miglihad ne me timpu, minsan te si Saul pad ka Hari, sikeykew e ka migpangulu te Israil te pegbubunu. Ne ingkahiyan ka te Magbebaye ne Manama nu, ‘Sikeykew ka egtanggu[fn] te keet-etawan ku ne me Israilita wey egkeyimu ka ne pangulu ran.’ ” 3 Purisu te pegginguma te langun ne igbuyag te Israil diye te Hibrun, miggimu e si Dabid te kasabutan duma kandan, diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne in-alam dan si Dabid isip Hari te Israil, sumale te insaad te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi ki Samwil.

111 And all from_Israil went_there to Dabid there at Hibrun and said, “We(excl) are very_much your(sg) relative(s) indeed. 2 In past times, even when Saul (was) still the king, you(sg) (were) the (one who) leading Israil to fighting. And you(sg) were_told by the Lord your(sg) God, ‘You(sg) (are) the (one who) will_care_for[fn] my people the (ones) from_Israil and you(sg) will_become their leader.’ ” 3 Therefore at the arriving of all the elders of Israil there at Hibrun, Dabid made an agreement along_with them, there in front of the Lord God. And they chose Dabid as king of Israil, according to what_was_promised by the Lord God by_means of Samwil.

4 [xr]Ne inlusuran ni Dabid duma te langun ne sundalu te Israil, ka Hirusalim ne egngaranan pad te Hibus, wey me Hibusihanen pad ka nangugpe. 5-6 Ne migkahiyan si Dabid te me Hibusihanen, “Kene kew egpakaseled kayi.” Ne ingkahiyan ni Dabid ka me etew rin, “Hentew seeye se hun-a ne egpakalusud te me Hibusihanen, eggimuwen ku ne pangulu te me sundalu.” Ne si Huwab ne anak ni Siruya ka hun-a ne miglusud, ne neyimu iya sikandin ne pangulu. Purisu naahew iya enni Dabid ka malig-en ne inged ne Hirusalim,[fn] ne nataman ingngaranan e seini te Siyudad ni Dabid 7 su diye mig-ugpe si Dabid te sika ne inged ne malig-en. 8 Ne imparakelan din pad ka siyudad puun diye te imbunelan te tane[fn] taman te nakalingut ne me inged, wey si Huwab degma ka mig-ayad-ayad te duma ne baad te siyudad. 9 Ne nanasnasian pad ka karesen ni Dabid su migduma ma kandin ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye.

4 [xr]And Hirusalim that was_ still _named Hibus, and Hibusihanons still lived(pl) (there), was_invaded by Dabid along_with all the soldiers of Israil. 5-6 And Dabid was_told by the Hibusihanons, “You(pl) won't be_able_to_enter here.” And Dabid said to his men, “Whoever is_first to_invade the Hibusihanons, I will_make leader of the soldiers.” And Huwab the child of Siruya (was) the first to_invade, and he indeed became commander. Therefore indeed Dabid and_company snatched the strong place of Siyun,[fn] and then this was_named the City of Dabid 7 because Dabid lived there in that strong place. 8 And he enlarged the city from the filled_in land[fn] until the surrounding places, and Huwab also repaired other portions of the city. 9 And the strength of Dabid increased because the Very Strong Lord accompanied him.

Ka me bahani ni Dabid

The warriors of Dabid

10 Seini ka me pangulu te me bahani ni Dabid. Sikandan wey ka langun ne matig-Israil ka migbulig kandin ne egkeyimu ne Hari sumale te insaad te Magbebaye ne Manama.

10 These (were) the leaders of the warriors of Dabid. They and all from_Israil helped him to_become king according to what_was_promised by the Lord God.

11 Seini ka listaan te me bahani: si Hisbaam ne Hakmunihanen iyan ka pangulu te tatelu ne me bahani. Nakapatey sikandin te tatelu ne gatus (300) ne me bahani pinaahi te deldeg te sabeka re ne gira. 12 Ne iyan igkarangeb si Iliyasar ne anak ni Dudu ne Ahuwahanen. Sabeka si Iliyasar te tatelu ne me bahani. 13 Migduma sikandin ki Dabid diye te Pisdumin taheed te miglibulung diye ka me Pilistihanen eyew te pegbubunu. Ne diye sikandan migpabunbunuey te due kamet ne neempet te sibada. Ne nenakapallahuy ka me matig-Israil, 14 piru ware mule mig-awe si Iliyasar wey si Dabid diye te taliware te kamet wey natalu ran iya ka me Pilistihanen. Impepanalu sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

11 This (was) the list of warriors: Hisbaam the Hakmunihanon (was) the leader of three warriors. He was_able_to_kill three hundred (300) warriors by_means of the spear in just one war. 12 And the second (was) Iliyasar child of Dudu the Ahuwahanon. Iliyasar (was) one of three warriors. 13 He accompanied Dabid there to Pisdumin while the Pilistihanons were_gathered there in_order for fighting. And they fought_each_other there (where) there_was a field covered with barley. And the (ones) from_Israil fled(pl), 14 but Iliyasar and Dabid on_the_contrary didn't leave there in the middle of the field and indeed they defeated the Pilistihanons. They were_made_to_win by the Lord God.

15 Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye ki Dabid diye te sulung te Adulam ka tatelu ne sundalu rin. Seini se tatelu nalagkes te Tatelu ne Pulu ne me mabbulut ne sundalu rin. Te seeye ne timpu migkekampu ka me sundalu te me Pilistihanen diye te Bangalug te Ripaim, 16 wey te Bitlihim. Ne si Dabid diye te malig-en ne inged din. 17 Ne nammaraan si Dabid wey migkahi, “Meupiya ubag perem ke due sabeka ne egsakug te weyig diye te belun ne marani te gumawan te Bitlihim, eyew eg-inumen ku!” 18 Sikan naa ka miggeles-heles miggendiye ka tatelu ne bahani te kampu te Pilistihanen wey migsakug te weyig diye te belun ne marani te gumawan te Bitlihim. Ne in-uyan dan e ka weyig diye ki Dabid piru ware din seini inuma. Nasi din seini itisa diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama isip halad. 19 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Manama, kene ku iya seini eg-inumen. Su ke eg-inumen ku seini, iling de te in-inum ku ka langesa te me etew ne ware mig-ulung-ulung ne migsakug te weyig.” Purisu, ware din seeye inuma. Seeye ka inggimu te tatelu ne bahani.

15 One day, his three soldiers went_there to Dabid there at the cave of Adulam. These three were_included in his Thirty fierce(pl) soldiers. At that time the soldiers of the Pilistihanons were_camped there in the Valley of Ripaim, 16 and at Bitlihim. And Dabid (was) there in his strong place. 17 And Dabid was_thirsty and said, “It would be good [hopefully] [politely] if there_was one that would_fetch water there from the well near the doorway of Bitlihim, so_that I (can) drink (it)!” 18 So then the three warriors secretly went_there to the camp of the Pilistihanons and drew water there from the well near the entrance of Bitlihim. And they took the water to Dabid but he didn't drink it. Instead he tipped_ it _out there in front of the Lord God as an offering. 19 And he said, “God, indeed I won't drink this. Because if I'll drink this, it's like that I drank the blood of people who drawing water without hesitation.” Therefore, he didn't drink it. That (was) what_ the three warriors _did.

20 Ne si Abisay ne suled ni Huwab ka pangulu te Tatelu ne Pulu ne me bahani. Nakapatey sikandin te tatelu ne gatus (300) ne etew ne iyan din inggamit ka deldeg din, wey migbantug degma sikandin iling te tatelu ne me bahani. 21 Sikandin ka amana ne mabantug te Tatelu ne Pulu wey neyimu sikandin ne pangulu ran, piru ware sikandin nakalagkes te seeye se tatelu.

20 And Abisay the sibling/cousin of Huwab (was) the leader of Thirty warriors. He killed three hundred (300) people just using his spear, and he also was_famous like the three warriors. 21 He (was) the excessively famous/honored of the Thirty and became their leader, but he wasn't included in those three.

22 Ne duen pad man-e mabulut ne etew ne si Binayas ne matig-Kabsiil ne anak ni Huyada. Masulug ka neyimu rin ne mabantug ne himu. Nakapatey sikandin te daruwa ne mabbantug ne me bahani ne matig-Muwab. Te timpu te tingmaagsil, migseled sikandin diye te lungag wey nekeyimatey man-e sikandin te liyun. 23 Ne nakapatey pad man-e sikandin te Ihiptuhanen ne pitu wey tenge ne palapala se kalayat. Miggehen-gen ka Ihiptuhanen te kalawit ne mabehat wey makepal. Piru migparani mule si Binayas ne mig-uyan de te tuked, wey in-ahew rin e ka kalawit te Ihiptuhanen, wey in-uney rin himatayi te kalawit din ded. 24 Seeye ka inggimu ni Binayas ne anak ni Huyada. Ne neyimu e sikandin ne iling kabantug te tatelu ne me bahani. 25 Sikandin ka subla ne mabantug du te Tatelu ne Pulu ne me duma rin, piru ware sikandin nakalagkes kandan. Ne inggimu sikandin ni Dabid ne pangulu te me talagbantey rin.

22 And there_was still a fierce person that (was) Binayas from_Kabsiil the child of Huyada. He did many (things) that (were) famous/honored act(s). He killed two famous/honored warriors from_Muwab. At the time of cold_season, he entered there in a hole and he also killed a lion. 23 And he also killed an Ihiptuhanon that was seven and (a) half feet tall (LIT long). The Ihiptuhanon was_holding a spear that (was) heavy and thick. But Binayas approached nevertheless carrying just a staff, and he snatched the spear of the Ihiptuhanon, and he killed him with just his very_own spear. 24 That (was) what_ Binayas the child of Huyada _did. And he became famous/honored like the three warriors. 25 He became more famous/honored that his Thirty companions, but he wasn't included with_them. And Dabid made him leader of his guards.

Ka me bahani ne migduma ki Dabid

The warriors that accompanied Dabid

121 Ne seini ka me etew ne miggendiye ki Dabid diye te Siklag te timpu ne miggeles-heles sikandin ki Saul ne anak ni Kis. Sikandan ka duma te me bahani ne migbulig ki Dabid te pegbubunu. 2 Neelin sikandan ne due me pane wey mangngateu sikandan ne egpane te kawanan wey ke gibang naa ne belad. Me karumaan sikandan ni Saul ne me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 3 Ne iyan dan me pangulu si Ahisir wey si Huwas, ne me anak ni Sama ne matig-Gibiya.

121 And these (were) the people who went_there to Dabid there at Siklag at the time that he was_hiding from Saul child of Kis. They (were) the other warriors that helped Dabid in fighting. 2 They all had bows and they were_skilled(pl) at shooting_with_bow with right or left arm(s)/hand(s). They (were) relatives of Saul (and) descendants of Binhamin. 3 And their leaders (were) Ahisir and Huwas, children of Sama from_Gibiya.

8 Ne ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Gad, migduma degma ki Dabid diye te malig-en ne inged ne helesanan din diye te disirtu. Me mabbulut sikandan iling te liyun, wey iling kaagsik-agsik te usa diye te me bubungan. 9 Si Isir ka pangulu ran, si Ubadiya ka ikarangeb, wey si Iliyab ka igkatatelu, 10 si Mismana ka igkeep-at, wey si Hirimiyas ka igkalalimma, 11 si Atay ka igkeen-em, si Iliil ka igkapitu, 12 si Diyuhanan ka igkawalu, si Ilsabad ka igkasiyam, 13 si Hirimiyas ka igkasapulu, wey si Makbanay ka igkasapulu wey sabeka.

8 And the other descendants of Gad, also accompanied Dabid there to the strong place that (was) his hiding_place there in the desert. They (were) warriors and practised(pl) fighting and they were_skilled(pl) at using shield(s) and spear(s). They (were) fierce like lions, and like the vigorousness of a deer there in the mountains. 9 Isir their leader, Ubadiya the next/second, and Iliyab the third, 10 Mismana the fourth, and Hirimiyas the fifth, 11 Atay the sixth, Iliil the seventh, 12 Diyuhanan the eighth, Ilsabad the ninth, 13 Hirimiyas the tenth, and Makbanay the eleventh.

14 Sikandan ka me kabuhalan ni Gad ne me upisyal te me sundalu. Sabeka ne gatus (100) de ne sundalu ka egkapanguluwan te kene amana ne mabantug wey sabeka ne libu (1,000) ka egkapanguluwan te amana ne mabantug. 15 Sikandan ka miglapas te Hurdan te an-anayan ne bulan te migbaggiyu seini, wey impandelrel ran ka nangugpe diye te me bangalug ne diye te igsile wey diye te iglineb.

14 They (were) the descendants of Gad that (were) officials of the soldiers. Just one hundred (100) soldiers (were) the (ones) led_by not very famous/honored (leaders) and one thousand (1,000) (were) the (ones) led_by very famous/honored (leaders). 15 They (were) the (ones who) crossed the Hurdan in the first month that it flooded, and they drove_away the (ones who) lived(pl) there in the valleys there in the east and there in the west.

16 Ne due duma ne me kabuhalan ni Binhamin wey ni Huda ne miggendiye ki Dabid diye te malig-en ne inged din. 17 Ne miglihawang si Dabid ka egsinug-ung kandan wey ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Ke miggendini kew eyew egbulig keddi isip alukuy, andam a ne egpakigsabeka kaniyu. Piru ke miggendini kew eyew te peg-akal, minsan ke ware sale ku, ka Manama te kaap-apuan ta ka nakakita kayi wey eggukum kaniyu.”

16 And there_were also descendants of Binhamin and of Huda that went_there to Dabid there to his strong place. 17 And Dabid exited to meet them and they were_told by_him, “If you(pl) came_here in_order to_help me as friend(s), I'm prepared to_unite with_you(pl). But if you(pl) came_here in_order for trapping, even if I have_no sin, the God of our(incl) ancestors (will be) the (one) to_see this and judge you(pl).”

18 Piru in-umaan te Panisingan te Manama si Amasay ne pangulu te Tatelu ne Pulu ne me bahani, wey migkahi,

Eglampus ka perem!

Because your(pl) God helps you(sg)!”

Purisu indawat sikandan ni Dabid wey inggimu rin e ne me upisyal te me sundalu rin.

Therefore they were_received by Dabid and he made (them) officials of his soldiers.

19 Due degma duma ne me etew ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Manasis ne migduma ki Dabid te pegduma rin te me Pilistihanen eyew egbubunu ki Saul. Piru ware nakapabulus si Dabid ne egduma kandan su ware ma migsuhut ka me Pilistihanen ne egduma sikandin kandan wey ka me etew rin, su naaldek sikandan ne ke ma ke eglapig ded si Dabid te ahalen din ne si Saul. Purisu pegkapenga te Pilistihanen te pegpasabutey, impeuli dan e si Dabid diye te Siklag. 20 Ne seini ka me etew ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Manasis ne miglapig ki Dabid te peggendiye din te Siklag: si Adna, si Husabad, si Hidiyail, si Maykil, si Husabad, si Ilihu, wey si Silitay. Ne ka tagse sabeka kandan migpangulu te tigsenge-libu ne me sundalu te kabuhalan ni Manasis. 21 Migbulig sikandan ki Dabid te egsukul te me kuntere ne egmanlusud, su me bahani ma sikandan wey me pangulu te me sundalu. 22 Ne aldew-aldew ka me etew ne egmangendiye ki Dabid eyew eglapig kandin, taman te migmasalig e amana ka me sundalu rin.

19 There_were also people from the descendant(s) of Manasis that accompanied Dabid on his accompanying the Pilistihanons in_order to_fight Saul. But Dabid didn't continue to_accompany them because the Pilistihanons didn't permit that he and his people accompany them, because they were_afraid what if Dabid just aligned_with his master Saul. Therefore when the Pilistihanons had_finished agreeing_with_each_other, they sent_ Dabid _home there to Siklag. 20 And these (were) the people from the descendant(s) of Manasis that aligned_with Dabid on his going_there to Siklag: Adna, Husabad, Hidiyail, Maykil, Husabad, Ilihu, and Silitay. And each one of_them led one_thousand_each soldiers of the descendant(s) of Manasis. 21 They helped Dabid to fight_against enemies that invaded(pl), because they (were) warriors and leaders of soldiers. 22 And each_day the people went_there(pl) to Dabid in_order to_align with_him, until his soldiers became_ very _many.

Ka peg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan

The bringing of the Container of the Agreement

(2 Sam 6:1‑11)

(2 Sam 6:1‑11)

131 Ne migpanginginse si Dabid diye te me kumandir te linibu wey te ginatus ne me sundalu rin, wey te langun ne pangulu te Israil. 2 Ne ingkahiyan ni Dabid ka langun ne keet-etawan te Israil ne nalibulung, “Ke eg-uyun kew wey ke igkeupii te Magbebaye ne Manama ta, egpeendiniyen ka me karumaan ta ne me matig-Israil ne diye te intiru ne tane te Israil duma te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita ne duma ran te nangugpe diye te me lungsud dan ne due me panabtaban. 3 Ne igpalibed ta kayi ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama su ware ma seini nasagman te timpu ni Saul.” 4 Ne mig-uyun ka langun te seini ne eggimuwen tenged su nakamaan-maan sikandan ne eleg seeye.

131 And Dabid asked(pl) the commanders of thousands and hundreds of his soldiers, and all the leaders of Israil. 2 And all the people of Israil that were_gathered were_told by Dabid, “If you(pl) agree and if our(incl) Lord God wants, command_ our(incl) relatives from_Israil there in the entire land of Israil along_with sacrificers and their companion Libitas that live(pl) there in their towns that have pastureland _to_come_here. 3 And we(incl) will_bring_back the Container of the Agreement of God because this hasn't been_given_attention from the time of Saul.” 4 And all agreed to doing this because they were_aware that it (was) correct.

5 [xr]Sikan naa, inlibulung ni Dabid ka langun ne me matig-Israil, puun te weyig te Sihur ne diye te marani te Ihiptu taman te Bayaanan te Hamat eyew eg-angey te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama ne diye te lungsud te Kiryat-Hiyarim. 6 [xr]Ne si Dabid wey ka masulug ne me matig-Israil, miggendiye te Baala ne egngaranan ded te Kiryat-Hiyarim ne sakup te Huda eyew eg-angey te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama ne ingngaranan te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama ne migpinnuu diye te elat-elat te me kirubin.[fn] 7 Indulan dan te iyam ne kerumata ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama puun te baley ni Abinadab. Ne si Usa wey Ahiyu ka mig-inahak te kerumata ne impahanuy te me baka. 8 Ne miggale-gale diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Dabid wey ka langun ne matig-Israil taman te egkeyimu ran pinaahi te me ulahingen, me lira, me alpa, me tambur, me kastanyita, wey me putew ne basalan.

5 [xr]So then, Dabid gathered all from_Israil, from the river Sihur there near Ihiptu until the Pass of Hamat in_order to_fetch the Container of the Agreement of God there in the town of Kiryat-Hiyarim. 6 [xr]And Dabid and many from_Israil, went_there to Baala also named Kiryat-Hiyarim under_the_jurisdiction of Huda in_order to_fetch the Container of the Agreement of God that's named with the name of the Lord God that sits there between the cherubims.[fn] 7 They cargoed the Container of the Agreement of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab. And Usa and Ahiyu (were) the (ones who) guided the cart that was_pulled by cows. 8 And Dabid and all from_Israil were_very_happy there in front of the Lord God as far as they could by_means of songs, lyres, harps, tambourines, castanets, and iron gongs.

9 Te pegginguma ran diye te inged ne diekanan ni Kidun, inggen-genan ni Usa ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan tenged su nasaligkat ka me baka. 10 Tenged dutu, nabelu amana ki Usa ka Magbebaye ne Manama tenged su inggen-genan din ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan, purisu inggimatayan e sikandin te Manama. 11 Ne nabelu si Dabid te inlegparan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Usa. Sikan naa ka ingngaranan ka seeye ne inged te Piris-Usa[fn] taman kuntee.

9 At their arrival there in the place of the threshing_place of Kidun, the Container of the Agreement was touched by Usa because the cows stumbled. 10 Due to that, the Lord God was_ very _angry at Usa because he touched the Container of the Agreement, therefore he was_killed by God. 11 And Dabid was_angry that the Lord God punished Usa. That's why that place was_named Piris-Usa[fn] until now/today.

12 Ne naaldek si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama te seeye ne aldew wey migkahi sikandin, “Egmenuwen ku naan e te eg-uyan diye te siyudad ku ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama?” 13 Purisu warad uyana ni Dabid ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te siyudad din. Sikan naa ka diyad e seini uyana te baley ni Ubid-Idum ne matig-Gat. 14 [xr]Ne diye nakatetahu te baley ni Ubid-Idum ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama te tatelu ne bulan. Ne impanalanginan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka pamilya ni Ubid-Idum wey ka langun ne kandin.

12 And Dabid was_afraid of the Lord God on that day and he said, “How (can) I bring the Container of the Agreement of God there to the my city?” 13 Therefore Dabid didn't fetch the Container of the Agreement there to his city. That's why it was_brought to the house of Ubid-Idum from_Gat. 14 [xr]And the Container of the Agreement of God got_put there in the house of Ubid-Idum for three months. And the Lord God blessed the family of Ubid-Idum and all that he owns.

Ka me himu ni Dabid diye te Hirusalim

The actions by Dabid there in Hirusalim

(2 Sam 2:11‑16)

(2 Sam 2:11‑16)

141 Ne migsuhu ka Hari te Tiru ne si Hiram te me suluhuanen peendiye ki Dabid, wey migpeuyan te me kayu ne sidar, me talagperi te batu, wey me talagbebaley eyew eggimu te palasyu ni Dabid. 2 Ne nanengnengan ni Dabid ne ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka miggimu kandin ne Hari te Israil wey ka amana migpanalangin te migharian din para te keupianan te keet-etawan din ne me matig-Israil.

141 And Hiram the king of Tiru commanded servants (to go) there to Dabid, and sent cedar wood/trees, splitters of stone, and builders in_order to_make the palace of Dabid. 2 Then Dabid realized that the Lord God (was) the (one who) made him king of Israil and the (one who) blessed his kingdom greatly for the peace/prosperity of his people from_Israil.

3 Ne migpangasawa pad si Dabid te masulug ne me malitan diye te Hirusalim, wey migmasalig pad ka me lukes wey me malitan ne me anak din. 4 Seini ka me ngaran te me anak ni Dabid ne neetew diye te Hirusalim: si Samuwa, si Subab, si Natan, si Sulumun, 5 si Ibhar, si Ilisuwa, si Ilpilit, 6 si Nuga, si Nipig, si Hapiya, 7 si Ilisama, si Biilyada, wey ka lein ne Ilipilit.

3 And Dabid married(pl) many females there in Hirusalim, and his male and female children became_many. 4 These (were) the names of the children of Dabid that were_born there in Hirusalim: Samuwa, Subab, Natan, Sulumun, 5 Ibhar, Ilisuwa, Ilpilit, 6 Nuga, Nipig, Hapiya, 7 Ilisama, Biilyada, and the other Ilipilit.

Ka pegkatalu te me Pilistihanen

The defeating of the Pilistihanons

(2 Sam 5:17‑25)

(2 Sam 5:17‑25)

8 Te pegkanengnengi te me Pilistihanen ne si Dabid e ka naalam ne Hari te Israil, nanakereg e sikandan langun eyew egdakep kandin. Piru nanengnengan seeye ni Dabid, wey insinug-ung din sikandan te egpakigbunu. 9 Ne miggingume e ka me Pilistihanen wey miglusuran dan e ka Bangalug te Ripaim. 10 Purisu mig-inse si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Eglusuran ku naa ka me Pilistihanen? Igpareeg nu naa sikandan keddi?”

8 When the Pilistihanons found_out that Dabid (was) the (one) chosen as king of Israil, they all ascended(pl) in_order to capture him. But Dabid found_out that, and he met them to_fight_with. 9 And the Pilistihanons had_arrived and they had_invaded the Valley of Ripaim. 10 Therefore Dabid questioned the Lord God, “Should I invade the Pilistihanons? Will you(sg) make_ me _victorious?”

Ne migtabak ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Uya, hipanew kad su igpareeg ku iya sikandan keykew.”

And the Lord God answered, “Yes, go(sg) because I will_ indeed _make_ you(sg) _victorious.”

11 Purisu miggendiyaan e enni Dabid ka me Pilistihanen diye te Baal-Pirasim[fn] wey natalu ran sikandan diye. Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Imparereetan keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me kuntere ku iling te nabusaye ne weyig.” Sikan naa ka ingngaranan seeye ne inged te Baal-Pirasim. 12 Ne neengkeran e te me Pilistihanen ka me diyus-diyus dan diye wey impepanilaban e seeye ni Dabid.

11 Therefore Dabid and_company went to the Pilistihanons there at Baal-Pirasim[fn] and they defeated them there. And Dabid said, “The Lord God caused_ me _to_destroy my enemies like the water burst_out.” That's why that place was_named Baal-Pirasim. 12 And their false_gods were_left_behind there by the Pilistihanons and those were_commanded_ by Dabid _to_be_burned(pl).

13 Ne nataman, miglusud e man-e mig-abey ka me Pilistihanen, diye te Bangalug te Ripaim. 14 Ne mig-abey e man-e mig-inse si Dabid te Manama wey migtabak ka Manama, “Kene niyu sikandan sinug-unga te eglusud, ke kene, linguti niyu sikandan wey diye niyu sikandan lusuri te egkatangkaan te me kayu ne balsamu. 15 Emun ke egkarineg niyu ka egwekes-wekes diye te uud te me kayu ne balsamu, lusud kew naan e su sika ka ilaan ne miggun-a a kaniyu ka egdereet te me Pilistihanen.” 16 Purisu intuman ni Dabid ka insuhu te Manama kandin wey impangimatayan dan ka me Pilistihanen puun te Giba taman te Gisir. 17 Purisu nekeempet te minsan hendei ne inged ka kabantug ni Dabid, wey inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkaaldek kandin ka langun ne nasud.

13 And then, the Pilistihanons invaded yet again, there in the Valley of Ripaim. 14 And Dabid asked again to God and God answered, “Don't(pl) meet them to_invade, but rather, encircle(pl) them and invade them there in front of the balsamu trees. 15 When you(pl) hear the noises there in the top of the balsamu trees, invade(pl) because that's the signal that the (one) destroying the Pilistihanons has_preceded you(pl).” 16 Therefore Dabid obeyed what_was_commanded to_him and they killed(pl) the Pilistihanons from Giba until Gisir. 17 Therefore what ever place was_covered with the fame of Dabid, and the Lord God made (it) that all nations were_afraid of him.

Ka peg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan

The bringing of the Container of the Agreement

151 Ne migpabebaley si Dabid te masulug diye te siyudad din. Ne mig-andam sikandin te egtahuan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama, wey inggimuwan din seini te balungbalung. 2 [xr]Ne migsuhu sikandin ne keilangan ne ka me Libita re ka eg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama, su sikandan ma ka in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama ne eg-uyan kayi, wey ka egpamakey kandin te ware egtamanan. 3 Ne impalibulung ni Dabid diye te Hirusalim ka langun ne keet-etawan te Israil eyew eg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama diye te in-andam din ne egtahuan kayi. 4 Ne impeumew degma ni Dabid ka me talagpanubad wey ka me Libita. 5 Ne due 120 ne etew ne egpuun te karumaan ni Kuhat ne impanguluwan ni Uril. 6 Ne due 220 ne etew ne egpuun te karumaan ni Mirari ne impanguluwan ni Asayas. 7 Ne due 130 ne etew ne egpuun te karumaan ni Girsum ne impanguluwan ni Huwil. 8 Ne due daruwa ne gatus (200) ne etew ne egpuun te karumaan ni Ilisapan ne impanguluwan ni Simaya. 9 Ne due walu ne pulu (80) ne etew ne egpuun te karumaan ni Hibrun ne impanguluwan ni Ilil. 10 Ne due 112 ne etew ne egpuun te karumaan ni Usil ne impanguluwan ni Aminadab. 11 Ne impeumew ni Dabid ka me talagpanubad ne si Saduk, si Abiyatar, wey ka me Libita ne si Uril, si Asiyas, si Huwil, si Simaya, si Ilil, wey si Aminadab. 12 Ne ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Me pangulu te me pamilya te me Libita, keilangan ne egmatulus kew te pegkeetew niyu wey ka langun ne duma niyu ne me Libita, eyew eg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, diye te in-andam ku ne egtahuan kayi. 13 Te an-anayan ne timpu kene ne sikaniyu ka mig-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, sikan naa ka inlegparan ki te Magbebaye ne Manama ta su ware ki ma mig-inse kandin te eleg ne paahi te peg-uyan kayi.”

151 And Dabid got_ many _houses built in his city. And he prepared a place_to_put the Container of the Agreement of God, and made a tent for it. 2 [xr]And he commanded that it's_necessary that just the Libitas bring the Container of the Agreement of God, because they (were) the (ones) chosen by the Lord God to bring it, and the (ones) to_serve him without ending. 3 And Dabid commanded_ all the people of Israil _to_gather in_order to_bring the Container of the Agreement of God there to the place_for it that_ he _had_prepared. 4 And Dabid also sent_for the sacrificers and the Libitas. 5 And there_were 120 people from the relative(s) of Kuhat that were_led by Uril. 6 And there_were 220 people from the relative(s) of Mirari that were_led by Asayas. 7 And there_were 130 people from the relative(s) of Girsum that were_led by Huwil. 8 And there_were two hundred (200) people from the relative(s) of Ilisapan that were_led by Simaya. 9 And there_were eighty (80) people from the relative(s) of Hibrun that were_led by Ilil. 10 And there_were 112 people from the relative(s) of Usil that were_led by Aminadab. 11 And Dabid sent_for the sacrificers Saduk, Abiyatar, and the Libitas Uril, Asiyas, Huwil, Simaya, Ilil, and Aminadab. 12 And they were_told by_him, “Leaders of families of Libitas, it's_necessary that you(pl) become_holy your(pl) selves and all your(pl) companion Libitas, in_order to_bring the Container of the Agreement of the Lord, the God of Israil, there to the place_for it that_ I _have_prepared. 13 The first time (it) wasn't you(pl) that brought the Container of the Agreement, that's why we(incl) were_punished by the Lord our(incl) God because we(incl) didn't ask him the correct way of bringing it.”

14 Purisu immatulus te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita ka pegkeetew ran eyew egkeuyan dan ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama te Israil. 15 [xr]Ne inyayungan te me Libita ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama, sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ki Muwisis.

14 Therefore the sacrificers and the Libitas made_ them selves _holy in_order for them to bring the Container of the Agreement of God of Israil. 15 [xr]And the Libitas carried_on_poles the Container of the Agreement of God, according to what_ the Lord _had_commanded Muwisis.

16 Ne imbanasalan ni Dabid ka me pangulu te me Libita ne eg-alam te me karumaan dan isip me talag-ulahing ne egbalesan te me lira, me alpa, wey me putew ne basalan. 17 Purisu in-alam te me Libita si Himan ne anak ni Huwil wey ka karumaan din ne me Libita ne si Asap ne anak ni Birikiyas, wey si Itan ne anak ni Kusiyas ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Mirari. 18 Ne ka naalam ne egbulig kandan iyan ka me karumaan dan ne si Sakariyas, si Hasiil, si Simiramut, si Hihiil, si Uni, si Iliyab, si Binayas, si Maasiyas, si Matatiyas, si Ilipilihu, si Makiniyas, wey ka me talagtameng te gumawan ne si Ubid-Idum wey si Hiil. 19 Ne ka me mangngulahing ne si Himan, si Asap, wey si Itan ka nenaalam ne talagparahing te putew ne basalan. 20 Ne si Sakariyas, si Asiil, si Simiramut, si Hihiil, si Uni, si Iliyab, si Maasiyas, wey si Binayas ka nenaalam ne egparahing te me alpa ne mematikang se dahing. 21 Ne si Matatiyas, si Ilipilihu, si Makiniyas, si Ubid-Idum, si Hiil, wey si Asasiyas ka nenaalam ne egparahing te me lira ne mallepet se dahing.

16 And the leaders of the Libitas were_encouraged by Dabid to_choose from their relatives as singers that would_get_rhythm from lyres, harps, and iron gongs. 17 Therefore Himan child of Huwil and his relative Libitas Asap child of Birikiyas, and Itan child of Kusiyas from the relatives of Mirari were_chosen by the Libitas. 18 And the (ones) chosen to_help them (were) their relatives Sakariyas, Hasiil, Simiramut, Hihiil, Uni, Iliyab, Binayas, Maasiyas, Matatiyas, Ilipilihu, Makiniyas, and the guards of the doorway Ubid-Idum and Hiil. 19 And the singers Himan, Asap, and Itan (were) the (ones) chosen(pl) as sounders of the iron gong(s). 20 And Sakariyas, Asiil, Simiramut, Hihiil, Uni, Iliyab, Maasiyas, and Binayas (were) the (ones) chosen(pl) to_sound the harps that's sound(s) (were) high(pl). 21 And Matatiyas, Ilipilihu, Makiniyas, Ubid-Idum, Hiil, and Asasiyas (were) the (ones) chosen(pl) to_sound the lyres that's sound(s) (were) short(pl).

22 Ne si Kininiyas ne pangulu te me Libita, iyan talagpanulu ke egmenuwen te eg-ulahing su amana ma sikandin ne egkateu ne eg-ulahing. 23 Ne si Birikiyas wey si Ilkana, iyan me talagbantey te gumawan te intahuan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama. 24 Ne ka me talagpanubad ne si Sibaniyas, si Husapat, si Natanail, si Amasay, si Sakariyas, si Binayas, wey si Ilisir, iyan me talaggiyup te me trumpita diye te tangkaan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama. Ne si Ubid-Idum wey si Hihiyas pad man-e ka me talagbantey te gumawan te intahuan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama.

22 And Kininiyas the leader of the Libitas, (was) teacher of how to sing because he (was) very skilled at singing. 23 And Birikiyas and Ilkana, (were) guards of the doorway of the place_for the Container of the Agreement of God. 24 And the sacrificers Sibaniyas, Husapat, Natanail, Amasay, Sakariyas, Binayas, Ilisir, (were) the blowers of trumpets there in front of the Container of the Agreement of God. And Ubid-Idum and Hihiyas also (were) the guards of the doorway of the place_for Container of the Agreement of God.

25 Purisu si Dabid wey ka me pangulu te Israil wey ka me upisyal te me sundalu, nangendiyad e te baley ni Ubid-Idum ka naggale-gale ne eg-angey te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye. 26 Ne tenged te imbulihan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me Libita ne mig-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye, migpanubad sikandan te pitu ne turu ne baka wey pitu ne lukesan ne karniru. 27 Ne migsaluub si Dabid te mahal ne hinabel wey iling ded degma ka langun ne Libita ne mig-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama, ka me mangngulahing, wey si Kininiyas ne pangulu te masulug ne eg-ulahing. Migsaluub man-e si Dabid te mateles ne kumbale ne egngaranan te ipud.[fn] 28 Ne in-uyan te langun ne me matig-Israil ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye wey migmanguleyi sikandan tenged te kahale, migparahing te eggiyupen ne me sungey, me trumpita, putew ne basalan, wey te meemen ne pegparahing te alpa wey te me lira.

25 Therefore Dabid and the leaders of Israil and the officials of soldiers, went_there to the house of Ubid-Idum happy(pl) to_fetch the Container of the Agreement of Lord. 26 And due to the Libitas being_helped by the Lord God to_carry the Container of the Agreement of the Lord, they sacrificed seven bull cows and seven male sheep. 27 And Dabid dressed in expensive cloth and just the_same also all the Libitas that carried the Container of the Agreement of God, the singers, and Kininiyas leader of many singers. 171 When Dabid moved_into the palace that he had_had_made, Natan the prophet was_told by_him, “I'm here now living in the palace made from cedar word, while on_the_contrary the Container of the Agreement of God is just placed in a tent.” 2 And Natan answered Dabid, “Make(sg) what ever (is) there in your(sg) thinking,[fn] because God will_accompany you(sg).”

3 Piru te sika ne marusilem, impanengneng te Manama si Natan, 4 “Hendiyei nu ka suluhuanen ku ne si Dabid wey kahii nu te kene ne sikandin ka egpasasindeg te baley ne eg-ugpaan ku. 5 Su te timpu te pegpalihawang ku te me matig-Israil puun te Ihiptu, wara a nekeugpe te baley, ke kene, diye de te eggal-halinen ne balungbalung. Su ware e re due nekeugpe te baley puun pad te pegpalihawang ku te me matig-Israil. 6 Miggalin-halin a mig-ugpe duma te langun ne me matig-Israil, wara a migkahi te me pangulu ran ne impabantey ku te keet-etawan ku te mania te kena a nikaniyu eggimuwan te baley ne puun te kayu ne sidar?

3 But on that very_night, God informed Natan, 4 “Go_there to my servant Dabid and tell(sg) (him) that it's not him that will_build a house that's my living_place. 5 Because at the time of my sending_out of the (ones) from_Israil from Ihiptu, I didn't live in a house, but rather, just there in tents often_moving. 6 Where ever I move_around along_with all from_Israil, I didn't say to their leaders that I asked_to_guard my peoplewhy haven't I been_built a house by_you(pl) made of cedar wood?

7 “Purisu kahii nu ka suluhuanen ku ne si Dabid te migkahi a se Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, ‘Talagtameng ka dengan te me karniru diye te panabtaban piru in-alam ku sikeykew ne egkeyimu ne pangulu te keet-etawan ku ne me matig-Israil. 8 Ne indumaan ku sikeykew minsan hendei ka migpabaye wey intalu ku ka langun ne me kuntere nu ne egkabayaan nu. Ne kuntee, eggimuwen ku sikeykew ne mabantug iling te mabantug ne me etew te kalibutan. 9 Egteilan ku te inged ne egpeugpaan ku ka keet-etawan ku ne matig-Israil wey igpeugpe ku sikandan diye eyew duen e tane dan mismu, wey kenad e sikandan egkasamuk. Ne kenad e egpakareeg-deeg kandan ka maddeet ne me etew iling te inggimu ran dengan, 10 te timpu ne mig-alam a te me pangulu eyew egmandu te keet-etawan ku ne me matig-Israil. Ne egtaluwen ku ka langun ne me kuntere nu. Sikeddi se Magbebaye ne Manama, egnangen keykew te due egkeyimu ne Hari puun te kabuhalan nu. 11 Ke egpatey kad e wey iglebeng e diye te inlebengan te kabuybuyahan nu, egpasubalen ku keykew ka sabeka te me kabuhalan nu, wey eggimuwen ku ne maresen ka migharian din. 12 Sikandin ka egpasasindeg te baley para keddi, wey egsihuruwen ku ne iyan eghari ka me kabuhalan din te ware egtamanan. 13 [xr]Egkeyimu ad ne amey rin, wey egkeyimu e sikandin ne anak ku. Ne kene ku eg-aween ka geyinawa ku kandin ne kene egkabalbalawan, kene ne iling te inggimu ku te Hari ne nasinundulan nu. 14 Igpiyal ku kandin ka keet-etawan ku wey ka migharian ku. Ne ka me kabuhalan din ka egkeyimu ne me Hari te ware katammanan.’ ”

7 “Therefore tell(sg) my servant Dabid that I the Very Strong/Powerful Lord said, ‘You(sg) (were) a watcher of sheep before there in the pasture but I chose you(sg) to_become leader of my people from_Israil. 8 And I accompanied you(sg) where ever you(sg) went and and I defeated all of your(sg) enemies that you(sg) passed_through. And his female children married their cousins/siblings that (were) children of their uncle Kis. 23 And Musi had three male children that (were) Mali, Idir, and Hirimut.

24 Sika ka me kabuhalan ni Libi ne nenalista se me ngaran diye te tagse pamilya ne nasakupan te tagse sabeka kandan. Ne iyan de immanlista ka daruwa ne pulu (20) se idad wey buyag-buyag e eyew egtrabahu diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 25 Su migkahi si Dabid, “Imbehayan ki te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil te keupianan, wey eg-ugpe sikandin kayi te Hirusalim te ware egtamanan. 26 [xr]Purisu kenad keilangan ne eg-uy-uyanen pad te me Libita ka Matulus ne Balungbalung ne In-alad wey ka langun ne kasangkapan ne eggamiten te pegsimba.” 27 Ne ka katammanan ne suhu ni Dabid iyan ka pegseel te me Libita ne daruwa ne pulu (20) se idad wey buyag-buyag e. 28 [xr]Ne iyan dan himu ka egbulig te me kabuhalan ni Aarun ne egtrabahu diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Sikandan ka talagtanggu te lama te timplu wey te me sinabeng, wey eglinis te langun ne matulus ne kasangkapan wey duma pad ne himu diye te timplu te Manama. 29 Sikandan man-e ka impiyalan te matulus ne paan ne igtahu diye te lamisa, te harina ne ighalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, te paan ne ware igpatulin, te paan ne impiritu wey te duma pad ne halad ne me linuyang. Sikandan degma ka impiyalan te egtimbang wey egtakes. 30 Katungdanan dan man-e ka egsasindeg diye te timplu tagse maselem wey maapun eyew egpasalamat wey egdayan te Magbebaye ne Manama, 31 wey te tagse timpu ne egtutung te igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama te Aldew te Peggimeley, Sahakeen te Iyam ne Bulan, wey te duma pad ne aldew te sahakeen. Ne due eg-ikulen dan ne balaud ke pila ne Libita ka egtrabahu wey ke egmenuwen dan te eggimu ka trabahu ran diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 32 Sikandan ka talagtanggu te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan wey te Matulus ne Balungbalung, wey ka egbulig te me karumaan dan ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun te egpamakey diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama.

24 Those (were) the descendants of Libi whose names were_listed(pl) there by each family that each one of_them is_a_member_of. And only those were_listed(pl) (who were) twenty (20) in_age and older in_order to_work there in the temple of the Lord God. 25 Because Dabid said, “We(incl) were_given peace/prosperity by the Lord God, the God of Israil, and he lives here in Hirusalim without ending. 26 [xr]Therefore it's_ no_longer _necessary that the Holy Tent that's Fenced be_carried_around by the Libitas and all the utensils that are_used in worshiping.” 27 And the final command of Dabid (was) the counting of the Libitas that (were) twenty (20) in_age and older. 28 [xr]And (what) they do (is) helping the descendants of Aarun to_work there in the temple of the Lord God. They (are) the carers of the yard of the temple and rooms, and to_clean all the holy utensils and other work there in the temple of God. 29 They also (are) the (ones) entrusted with the holy bread that's put there on the table, with the flour that's offered there to the Lord God, with bread without rising_agent, with bread that's fried and with still other offerings of dough (LIT slurry). They also (are) the (ones) entrusted with weighing and measuring. 30 It's their duty also to_stand there in the temple each morning and afternoon in_order to_give_thanks and to_praise the Lord God, 31 and each time that a sacrifice is burned there to the Lord God on the Day of Resting, Feast of New Moon/Month, and on other day(s) of feast(s). And there_is a rule that_ they _follow about how many Libitas to work and how they do their work there in front of the Lord God. 32 They (are) the (ones) to_look_after the Tent that's a Meeting_place and the Holy Tent, and the (ones) to_help their relatives the descendants of Aarun to_serve there in the temple of the Lord God.

Ka pegbaad-baad te me Libita

The dividing_up of the Libitas

241 Ne seini ka pegbaad-baad te me kabuhalan ni Aarun. Due hep-at ne anak ni Aarun ne me lukes ne iyan si Nadab, si Abihu, si Iliyasar, wey si Itamar. 2 [xr]Piru hun-a ne nammatey si Nadab wey si Abihu du te amey ran, wey ware me anak dan. Purisu iyan de neneyimu ne me talagpanubad si Iliyasar wey si Itamar. 3 Ne imbaad-baad ni Dabid ka me kabuhalan ni Aarun sumale te me katungdanan ne igpeyimu kandan. Imbulihan sikandin ni Saduk ne kabuhalan ni Iliyasar, wey ni Ahimilik ne kabuhalan ni Itamar. 4 Ne imbaad-baad te sapulu wey hen-em (16) ne punduk ka me kabuhalan ni Iliyasar tenged su nakita ne masmasulug ka me lukes ne pangulu te pamilya rin du te kabuhalan ni Itamar. Sikan naa ka imbaad-baad de te walu ne punduk ka pamilya ni Itamar. 5 Ne imbaad-baad sikandan ni Dabid pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut tenged su duen ma me upisyal te timplu wey me suluhuanen te Manama ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Iliyasar wey ni Itamar. 6 Ne si Simaya ne anak ni Nitanil ne Libita iyan ka sikritari. Impanlista rin ka me ngaran te me talagpanubad diye te tangkaan te Hari wey te me upisyal rin, ni Saduk ne talagpanubad, ni Abimilik ne anak ni Abiyatar, wey te me pangulu te me pamilya te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita. Impegsinsinundul te egpintut-pintut ka me kabuhalan ni Iliyasar wey ni Itamar.

241 And this (was) the dividing_up of the descendants of Aarun. There_were four male children of Aarun that (were) Nadab, Abihu, Iliyasar, and Itamar. 2 [xr]But Nadab and Abihu died(pl) before their father, and they had_no children. Therefore only Iliyasar and Itamar became(pl) sacrificers. 3 And Dabid divided_up the descendants of Aarun according to the duties that were_expected of_them. He was_helped by Saduk the descendant of Iliyasar, and by Ahimilik the descendant of Itamar. 4 And the descendants of Iliyasar were_divided into sixteen (16) groups because it_was_seen that (there were) more males that (were) leaders of his family than descendants of Itamar. That's why the family of Itamar was_ just _divided into eight groups. 5 And they were_divided by Dabid by_means of drawing_lots because there_were officials of the temple and servants of God from the descendant(s) of Iliyasar and of Itamar. 6 And Simaya the child of Nitanil the Libita (was) the secretary. He listed(pl) the names of the sacrificers there in front of the king and his officials, Saduk the sacrificer, Abimilik the child of Abiyatar, and leaders of families of sacrificers and Libitas. The descendants of Iliyasar and of Itamar kept_following_each_other in drawing_lots.

7 Ka an-anayan ne napintutan iyan si Hihuyarib, ka igkarangeb iyan si Hidayas, 8 ka igkatelu iyan si Harim, ka igkeep-at iyan si Siyurim, 9 ka igkakalimma iyan si Malkiyas, ka igkeen-em iyan si Mihamin, 10 ka igkapitu iyan si Hakus, ka igkawalu iyan si Abiyas, 11 ka igkasiyam iyan si Hiswa, ka igkasapulu iyan si Sikaniyas, 12 ka igkasapulu wey sabeka (11) iyan si Iliyasib, ka igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) iyan si Hakim, 13 ka igkasapulu wey tatelu (13) iyan si Hupa, ka igkasapulu wey hep-at (14) iyan si Isbab, 14 ka igkasapulu wey lalimma (15) iyan si Bilga, ka igkasapulu wey hen-em (16) iyan si Imir, 15 ka igkasapulu wey pitu (17) iyan si Hisir, ka igkasapulu wey walu (18) iyan si Hapisis, 16 ka igkasapulu wey siyam (19) iyan si Pitahiyas, ka igkararuwa ne pulu (20) iyan si Hihiskil, 17 ka igkararuwa ne pulu wey sabeka (21) iyan si Hakin, ka igkararuwa ne pulu wey daruwa (22) iyan si Gamul, 18 ka igkararuwa ne pulu wey tatelu (23) iyan si Dilayas, ka igkararuwa ne pulu wey hep-at (24) iyan si Maasiyas.

7 The first that was_chosen_by_lot (was) Hihuyarib, the second (was) Hidayas, 8 the third (was) Harim, the fourth (was) Siyurim, 9 the fifth (was) Malkiyas, the sixth (was) Mihamin, 10 the seventh (was) Hakus, the eighth (was) Abiyas, 11 the ninth (was) Hiswa, the tenth (was) Sikaniyas, 12 the eleventh (11) (was) Iliyasib, the twelfth (12) (was) Hakim, 13 the thirteenth (13) (was) Hupa, the fourteenth (14) (was) Isbab, 14 the fifteenth (15) (was) Bilga, the sixteenth (16) (was) Imir, 15 the seventeenth (17) (was) Hisir, the eighteenth (18) (was) Hapisis, 16 the nineteenth (19) (was) Pitahiyas, the twentieth (20) (was) Hihiskil, 17 the twenty first (21) (was) Hakin, the twenty second (22) (was) Gamul, 18 the twenty third (23) (was) Dilayas, the twenty fourth (24) (was) Maasiyas.

19 Ne inggimu te tagse punduk ka me himu ran diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama sumale te me balaud ne imbehey te kaapuan dan ne si Aarun ne egpuun te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil.

19 And each group did their work there in the temple of the Lord God according to the laws that were_given to their ancestor Aarun from the Lord God, the God of Israil.

20 Ne seini ka duma ne me pangulu te me kabuhalan ni Libi:

20 And these (were) the other leaders of the descendants of Libi:

si Hidiyas ne kabuhalan ni Sibuwil, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Amram;

Hidiyas the descendant of Sibuwil, from the descendant(s) of Amram;

21 si Isiyas, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Rihabiyas;

21 Isiyas, from the descendant(s) of Rihabiyas;

22 si Diyahat ne kabuhalan ni Salamit, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Isar;

22 Diyahat the descendant of Salamit, from the descendant(s) of Isar;

23 si Hiriyas ka labew ne pangulu, si Amariyas ka igkarangeb, si Diyahasil ka ikatatelu, wey si Hikamiyam ka igkeep-at, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Hibrun;

23 Hiriyas the prominent leader, Amariyas the second, Diyahasil the third, and Hikamiyam the fourth, from(pl) the descendant(s) of Hibrun;

24 si Samir ne kabuhalan ni Mika, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Usil;

24 Samir the descendant of Mika, from the descendant(s) of Usil;

25 si Sakariyas, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Isiyas ne suled ni Mika ne kabuhalan ni Usil;

25 Sakariyas, from the descendant(s) of Isiyas the sibling/cousin of Mika the descendant of Usil;

26 si Mali wey si Musi ne me kabuhalan ni Mirari; si Binu, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Haasiyas;

26 Mali and Musi the descendants of Mirari; Binu, from the descendant(s) of Haasiyas;

27 si Binu, si Sumam, si Sakur, wey Ibri, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Mirari; 28 si Iliyasar ne ware anak ne lukes, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Mali; 29 si Hiramil, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Kis; 30 si Mali, Idir, wey si Hirimut, ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Musi.

27 Binu, Sumam, Sakur, and Ibri, from(pl) the descendant(s) of Mirari; 28 Iliyasar without male children, from the descendant(s) of Mali; 29 Hiramil, from the descendant(s) of Kis; 30 Mali, Idir, and Hirimut, from(pl) the descendant(s) of Musi.

Seeye ka me kabuhalan ni Libi ne nalista sumale te pamilya ran.

Those (were) the descendants of Libi that were_listed according to their family(s).

31 Ne migpintut-pintut degma sikandan eyew te pegbaad-baad te me himu ran iling te inggimu te me karumaan dan ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun diye te tangkaan ni Hari Dabid, ni Saduk, ni Ahimilik, wey te me pangulu te me pamilya, te me talagpanubad, wey te me Libita. Migpintut-pintut ka me pangulu minsan ka me bate-bate pad.

31 And they drew_lots also in_order for dividing their work like was_done by their relatives the descendants of Aarun there in front of King Dabid, of Saduk, of Ahimilik, and of the leaders of families, of the sacrificers, and of the Libitas. The leaders drew_lots even (those) still young.

Ka me talag-ulahing diye te timplu

The singers there at the temple

251 Ne si Dabid wey ka me upisyal te me sundalu, mig-alam te me anak ni Asap, ni Himan, wey ni Hidutun eyew iyan egpangguhud te igpanengneng te Manama ne egbalesan te me alpa, me lira, wey te me putew ne egbasalan. Ne seini ka listaan te me ngaran dan wey te me katungdanan dan:

251 And Dabid and the officials of the soldiers, chose the children of Asap, of Himan, and of Hidutun in_order to_story what_ God _wants_informed to_the_beat of harps, lyres, and iron gongs. And this (is) the list of their names and of their duties:

2 Egpuun te me anak ni Asap: si Sakur, si Husi, si Nataniyas, wey si Asarila. Ne si Asap ne amey ran ka migpangulu kandan te egpangguhud te igpanengneng te Manama ke egsuhuen sikandan te Hari.

2 From the children of Asap: Sakur, Husi, Nataniyas, and Asarila. And Asap their father (was) the (one who) led them to story what_ God _wanted_known if they were_commanded by the king.

3 Egpuun te me anak ni Hidutun: si Gidaliyas, si Suri, si Hisayas, si Simii, si Hasabiyas, wey si Mataniyas; hen-em (6) dan langun. Ne si Hidutun ne amey ran ka migpangulu kandan te egpangguhud te igpanengneng te Manama, egpasalamat wey egdeyrey te Magbebaye ne egbalesan te lira. 4 Egpuun te me anak ni Himan: si Bukiyas, si Mataniyas, si Usil, si Sibuwil, si Hirimut, si Hananiyas, si Hanani, si Iliyata, si Gidalti, si Rumantisir, si Husbikasa, si Miluti, si Hutir, wey si Mahasiyut. 5 Me anak sikandan langun ni Himan ne prupita te Hari. Impabantug si Himan te Manama pinaahi te pegbehey kandin te sapulu wey hep-at (14) ne anak ne me lukes wey tatelu ne malitan, sumale te insaad kandin te Manama. 6 Impanguluwan din ka langun ne anak din ne me lukes te pegparahing te me simbal, me lira, wey me alpa te pegpamakey ran diye te timplu te Manama. Ne ka Hari mismu ka migsuhu engki Asap, Hidutun, wey ki Himan.

3 From the children of Hidutun: Gidaliyas, Suri, Hisayas, Simii, Hasabiyas, and Mataniyas; they were six (6) altogether. And Hidutun their father (was) the (one who) led them to story what_ God _wanted_known, give_thanks and praise the Lord accompanied_with lyre. 4 From the children of Himan: Bukiyas, Mataniyas, Usil, Sibuwil, Hirimut, Hananiyas, Hanani, Iliyata, Gidalti, Rumantisir, Husbikasa, Miluti, Hutir, and Mahasiyut. 5 They all (are) children of Himan the prophet of the king. God made_ Himan _honored by_means of giving him fourteen (14) male children and three females, according to what_was_promised by God to_him. 6 He led all his male children in sounding cymbals, lyres, and harps in their serving there in the temple of God. And the king himself commanded Asap, Hidutun, and Himan.

7 Migginguma sikandan langun te daruwa ne gatus wey walu ne pulu wey walu (288) lagkes ka me karumaan dan. Nenabasbas langun sikandan ne eg-ulahing para te Magbebaye ne Manama. 8 Ne migpintut-pintut sikandan, bate ma wey se buyag, talagpanulu ma wey se hibateen, eyew egkanengnengan dan ke nekey ka me katungdanan dan.

7 They all came_to two hundred and eighty and eight (288) including their relatives. They all practised(pl) singing for the Lord God. 8 And they drew_lots, young and old, teacher and disciple, so_that they would_know what their duties (were).

Ka me talagbantey te gumawan te timplu

The guards of the doorway of the temple

261 Seini ka me punduk te me talagbantey te gumawan te timplu: puun te me kabuhalan ni Kura, si Misilimiyas ne anak ni Kuri ne sabeka te me anak ni Asap. 2 Si Misilimiyas due pitu ne anak ne me lukes ne iyan si Sakariyas ka kinakakayan, si Hidiyail ka igkarangeb, si Sibadiyas ka igkatelu, si Hatanail ka igkeep-at, 3 si Ilam ka igkalimma, si Diyuhanan ka igkeen-em, wey si Iliyunay ka igkapitu.

261 These (are) the groups of guards of the doorway of the temple: from the descendants of Kura, Misilimiyas child of Kuri one of the children of Asap. 2 Misilimiyas had seven male children that (were) Sakariyas the oldest, Hidiyail the second, Sibadiyas the third, Hatanail the fourth, 3 Ilam the fifth, Diyuhanan the sixth, and Iliyunay the seventh.

4 [xr]Ne due etew ne egngaranan ki Ubid-Idum ne due walu ne anak ne lukes: si Simaya ka kinakakayan, si Husabad ka igkarangeb, si Huwa ka igkatelu, si Sakar ka igkeep-at, si Natanail ka igkalalimma, 5 si Amil ka igkeen-em, si Isakar ka igkapitu, wey si Pulati ka igkawalu.

4 [xr]And there_was a person named Ubid-Idum that had eight male children: Simaya the oldest, Husabad the second, Huwa the third, Sakar the fourth, Natanail the fifth, 5 Amil the sixth, Isakar the seventh, and Pulati the eighth.

6 Ne si Simaya ne kinakakayan ne anak ni Ubid-Idum, due me anak ne me lukes ne iyan me pangulu te me pamilya ran su amana ma sikandan egkasalihan ne me lukes. 7 Ne ka me anak ni Simaya ne me lukes iyan si Utni, si Rapail, si Ubid, si Ilsabad wey ka me karumaan din ne si Ilihu, wey si Samakiyas ne due me katuenan ne me lukes.

6 And Simaya the oldest child of Ubid-Idum, had children who (were) leaders of their families because they were_ very _trustworthy males. 7 And the male children of Simaya (were) Utni, Rapail, Ubid, Ilsabad and his relatives Ilihu, and Samakiyas that (were) males that had skills.

8 Hen-em ne pulu wey daruwa (62) langun ka me kabuhalan ni Ubid-Idum, lagkes ka me anak dan wey ka me karumaan dan ne amana egkasalihan te pegtrabahu.

8 All the descendants of Ubid-Idum (were) sixty two (62), including their children and their relatives that were_ very _trustworthy in working.

9 Ne si Misilimiyas due me anak ne me lukes wey me karumaan ne derakel degma se me katuenan. Sapulu wey walu (18) ran langun.

9 And Misilimiyas had male children and relatives that also (had) many/large(pl) skills. They all (are) eighteen (18).

10 Ne si Husa ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Mirari due hep-at ne anak ne me lukes: si Simri, ka pangulu ran minsan kene ne sikandin ka kinakakayan, 11 si Hilkiyas ka igkarangeb, si Tibaliyas ka igkatatelu, wey si Sakariyas ka igkeep-at. Sapulu wey tatelu (13) langun ka karumaan wey me anak ne me lukes ni Husa.

10 And Husa from the descendants of Mirari had four male children: Simri, their leader even though he (was) not the oldest, 11 Hilkiyas (was) the second, Tibaliyas (was) the third, and Sakariyas (was) the fourth. The relative(s) and male children of Husa (were) thirteen (13) altogether.

12 Ne imbaad-baad te tigsengepunduk ka me talagbantey te me gumawan te timplu sumale te pangulu te me pamilya ran, wey impamehayan sikandan te me katungdanan diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama iling te me karumaan dan ne me Libita. 13 Ne migpintut-pintut ka tagse pamilya, me bate wey se me buyag e, eyew egkanengnengan dan ke hendei ne gumawan ka egbantayan dan. 14 Ne ka dapit te igsile ne gumawan iyan napintutan ne egbantayan ni Silimiyas. Ne ka gumawan ne dapit te igkahibang ne balabahan, iyan napintutan ne egbantayan te anak din ne si Sakariyas. Si Sakariyas matagseb ne talagtambag. 15 Ne ka dapit te igkakawanan ne balabahan ne gumawan iyan napintutan ne egbantayan ni Ubid-Idum wey ka baley ne tahuanan iyan napintutan ne egbantayan te me anak din. 16 Ne ka dapit te iglineb ne gumawan wey ka gumawan te timplu ne peendiye te dibabew ne dalan iyan napintutan ne egbantayan ni Supim wey ni Husa. Egpasubsubaley sikandan ka egbebantey. 17 Te tagse aldew, hen-em ne Libita ka egbantey diye te gumawan ne dapit te igsile, hep-at ka diye te gumawan ne dapit te igkahibang ne balabahan, hep-at ka diye te gumawan ne dapit te igkakawanan ne balabahan, wey tigdaruwa ka diye te tagse baley ne tinesanan. 18 Ne due hen-em ne migbantey diye te iglineb—hep-at ka diye te gumawan peendiye te dibabew te timplu, wey daruwa ka diye te lama. 19 Seeye ka himu te me punduk te me talagbantey te gumawan ne me kabuhalan ni Kura wey ni Mirari.

12 And the guards of the doorways of the temple were_divided into each_group according to the leader of their families, and they were_distributed with duties there in the temple of the Lord God like their relatives the Libitas. 13 And each family drew_lots, young and old, so_that (it) would_be_known which doorway (was) theirs to_guard. 14 And the doorway facing east was_drawn to_be_guarded by Silimiyas. And the doorway facing north (LIT left side), was_drawn to_be_guarded by his child Sakariyas. Sakariyas (was) a wise advisor. 15 And the south (LIT right side) doorway was_drawn by Ubid-Idum and the house that's a storage_place was_drawn to_be_guarded by his children. 16 And the west doorway and the doorway of the temple that's towards the top road was_drawn to_be_guarded by Supim and by Husa. They would_take_turns to_guard. 17 Each day, six Libitas would_guard the gate there in the east, four there at the gate in the north (LIT left side), four there at the gate in the south (LIT right side), and two_each there in each house that's a storage_place. 18 And there_were six that guarded there on the west—four there at the doorway going_towards the top of the temple, and two there in the courtyard. 19 Those (were) the work of groups of guards of the doorway(s) that (were) descendants of Kura and of Mirari.

Ka me talagbantey te me kasangkapan

The guards of utensils/equipments

20 Ne ka duma ne Libita iyan impiyalan te me baley ne tinesanan te karatuan diye te timplu te Manama wey te me kasangkapan ne inhalad e diye te Manama. 21 Ne iyan pangulu si Hihil ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Ladan ne kabuhalan ni Girsun. 22 Ne due daruwa ne anak ni Hihil ne me lukes ne si Sitam wey si Huwil ne iyan impiyalan te me tahuanan te karatuan diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama.

20 And the other Libita(s) (were) entrusted the houses that's a storage_place of wealth there at the temple of God and the utensils/equipments that were_offered there to God. 21 And Hihil from the descendants of Ladan the descendant of Girsun (was) the leader. 22 And there_were two male children of Hihil that (were) Sitam and Huwil that were_entrusted the houses that's a storage_place of wealth there in the temple of the Lord God.

23 Seeye ded ne himu ka impeyimu te me kabuhalan ni Amram, ni Isar, ni Hibrun, wey ni Usil.

23 Those similar works were_expected_to_be_done by the descendants of Amram, of Isar, of Hibrun, and of Usil.

24 Si Sibuwil ne kabuhalan ni Girsun ne anak ni Muwisis iyan pangulu te impiyalan diye te me baley ne tinesanan te karatuan. 25 Ne ka me karumaan din ne me kabuhalan ni Ilisir iyan si Rihabiyas, si Hisayas, si Huram, si Sikri, wey si Silumit. 26 Ne si Silumit wey ka me karumaan din, iyan impiyalan te me baley ne tinesanan te me kasangkapan ne inhalad diye te Manama—ka me kasangkapan ne inhalad ni Hari Dabid wey te me pangulu te linibu wey ginatus ne me sundalu wey te duma pad ne me upisyal. 27 Inhalad dan man-e te Manama ka duma ne me kasangkapan ne naahew ran puun te me kuntere dan eyew eggamiten te eg-ayad-ayad te timplu te Magbebaye. 28 Ne ka langun degma ne inhalad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ni prupita Samwil, ni Saul ne anak ni Kis, ni Abnir ne anak ni Nir, wey ni Huwab ne anak ni Siruya, wey ka duma pad ne me kasangkapan ne nakahalad e, impiyal red man-e ki Silumit wey te me karumaan din.

24 And Sibuwil the descendant of Girsun the child of Muwisis (was) leader of (those) entrusted there at the houses that's a storage_place of wealth. 25 And his relatives that (were) the descendants of Ilisir (were) Rihabiyas, Hisayas, Huram, Sikri, and Silumit. 26 And Silumit and his relatives, were_entrusted with the houses that's storage_place(s) of utensils/equipments that were_offered there to God—the utensils/equipments that were_offered by King Dabid and by the leaders of thousands and hundreds of soldiers and by still other officials. 27 The other utensils/equipments that they snatched from their enemies were_ also _offered by_them to God in_order to_be_used for fixing the temple of the Lord. 28 And also all that was_offered to the Lord God by the prophet Samwil, by Saul child of Kis, by Abnir child of Nir, and by Huwab child of Siruya, and the still other utensils/equipments that had_been_offered, were_ just also _entrusted to Silumit and to his relatives.

Ka himu te duma ne Libita

The work of other Libita(s)

29 Puun te me kabuhalan ni Ishar, si Kininiyas wey ka anak din ne me lukes iyan impiyalan te katungdanan diye te lihawangan te timplu isip me upisyal wey me talaggukum te intiru ne Israil.

29 From the descendants of Ishar, Kininiyas and his male children were_entrusted with duties there outside the temple as officials and judges for entire Israil.

30 Puun te me kabuhalan ni Hibrun, si Hasabiyas wey ka sabeka ne libu wey pitu ne gatus (1,700) ne me karumaan din ne derakel degma se me katuenan, iyan impiyalan ne egpangulu te tane ne diye te Weyig ne Hurdan, dapit te iglineb. Sikandan ka eggimu te me himu para te Magbebaye ne Manama wey te Hari. 31 Si Hiriyas ka pangulu te me pamilya ni Hibrun sumale te listaan te me kabuhalan. Su te igkeep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un te peghari ni Dabid, impasusi rin ka me listaan te me pamilya, wey nanengnengan dan ne duen bes me kabuhalan ni Hibrun diye te Hasir ne sakup te Gilyad, ne derakel degma se me katuenan. 32 Ne due daruwa ne libu wey pitu ne gatus (2,700) ne me karumaan ni Hiriyas ne derakel degma se me katuenan, wey me pangulu te me pamilya. Ne impamehayan sikandan ni Hari Dabid te me katenged te pegpangulu te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey te katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis eyew iyan eggimu te me himu te pegpamakey te Manama wey te Hari.

30 From the descendants of Hibrun, Hasabiyas and his one thousand and seven hundred (1,700) relatives that also (had) big/many skilled, were_entrusted to lead the land there at Hurdan River, facing west. They (were) the (ones who) did works for the Lord God and for the king. 31 Hiriyas (was) the leader of the family of Hibrun according to the list of descendants. Because for forty (40) years of the kinging by Dabid, he checked_out the lists of families, and they found_out that there_was [surprise] descendants of Hibrun there at Hasir under_the_jurisdiction of Gilyad, that also (had) big/many skills. 32 And there_were two thousand and seven hundred (2,700) relatives of Hiriyas that (had) big/many skills, and leaders of families. And they were_distributed duties by King Dabid for leading the descendants of Rubin, of Gad, and of half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) the descendants of Manasis so_that (they) would_do the works of serving God and the king.

Ka me upisyal ni Hari Dabid

The officials of King Dabid

271 Seini ka me listaan te me pangulu, te me kumandir te linibu wey te ginatus ne me sundalu, wey te me upisyal te me matig-Israil ne migpamakey te Hari isip me pangulu te me punduk. Te tagse bulan te intiru ne leg-un, due sabeka ne punduk te me sundalu ne egpamakey. Ka tagse punduk due daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu.

271 These (are) the lists of leaders, of commanders of thousands and hundreds of soldiers, and of officials of the (ones) from_Israil that served the king as leaders of groups. Each month for the entire year, there_was one group of soldiers that served. Each group had twenty and four thousand (24,000) soldiers.

2 Te an-anayan ne bulan, si Hasubim ne anak ni Sabdiil ka migpangulu te an-anayan ne punduk. Ne due daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din. 3 Kabuhalan sikandin ni Piris wey sikandin ka migpangulu te langun ne kumandir te me sundalu te an-anayan ne bulan.

2 In the first month, Hasubim child of Sabdiil (was) the (one who) led the first group. And there were twenty and four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group. 3 He (was) a descendant of Piris and he (was) the (one who) led all the commanders of the soldiers in the first month.

4 Te igkarangeb ne bulan, si Duday ne kabuhalan ni Ahuwa ka migpangulu te igkarangeb ne punduk. Ne si Miklut ka labew ne upisyal rin. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

4 In the second month, Duday descendant of Ahuwa (was) the (one who) led the second group. And Miklut (was) his prominent official. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

5 Te igkatatelu ne bulan, si Binayas ne anak ni Hihuyada ne talagpanubad ka migpangulu te igkatelu ne punduk. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din. 6 Seini ne Binayas ka migpangulu te punduk te me bahani ni Dabid ne neilaan te gennal ne Tatelu ne Pulu. Ne ka anak din ne si Amisabad iyan labew ne upisyal rin.

5 In the third month, Binayas child of Hihuyada the sacrificer (was) the (one who) led the third group. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group. 6 This Binayas (was) the (one who) led the group of warriors of Dabid that were_known by the nickname as Thirty. And his child Amisabad (was) his prominent official.

7 Te igkeep-at ne bulan, si Asahil ne suled ni Huwab ka migpangulu te igkeep-at ne punduk. Ne ka anak din si Sibadiyas ka nakasubal kandin. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

7 In the fourth month, Asahil the sibling/cousin of Huwab (was) the (one who) led the fourth group. And his child Sibadiyas (was) the (one who) replaced him. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

8 Te igkalalimma ne bulan, si Samhut ne kabuhalan ni Isra ka migpangulu te igkalalimma ne punduk. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

8 In the fifth month, Samhut descendant of Isra (was) the (one who) led the fifth group. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

9 Te igkeen-em ne bulan, si Ira ne anak ni Ikis ne matig-Tikuwa ka migpangulu te igkeen-em ne punduk. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

9 In the sixth month, Ira child of Ikis from_Tikuwa (was) the (one who) led the sixth group. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

10 Te igkapitu ne bulan, si Hilis ne kabuhalan ni Pilun ne kabuhalan ni Ipraim ka migpangulu te igkapitu ne punduk. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

10 In the seventh month, Hilis descendant of Pilun descendant of Ipraim (was) the (one who) led the seventh group. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

11 Te igkawalu ne bulan, si Sibikay ne kabuhalan ni Husa ne kabuhalan ni Sira ka migpangulu te igkawalu ne punduk. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

11 In the eighth month, Sibikay descendant of Husa descendant of Sira (was) the (one who) led the eighth group. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

12 Te igkasiyam ne bulan, si Abisir ne matig-Anatut ne kabuhalan ni Binhamin ka migpangulu. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

12 In the ninth month, Abisir from_Anatut descendant of Binhamin (was) the (one who) led. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

13 Te igkasapulu ne bulan, si Maharay ne matig-Nitupa ne kabuhalan ni Sira ka migpangulu te igkasapulu ne punduk. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

13 In the tenth month, Maharay from_Nitupa descendant of Sira (was) the (one who) led the tenth group. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

14 Te igkasapulu wey sabeka (11) ne bulan, si Binayas ne matig-Paratun ne kabuhalan ni Ipraim ka migpangulu te igkasapulu wey sabeka (11) ne punduk. Ne duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

14 In the eleventh (11) month, Binayas from_Paratun descendant of Ipraim (was) the (one who) led the eleventh (11) group. And there_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

15 Te igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) ne bulan, si Hilday ne matig-Nitupa ne kabuhalan ni Utnil ka migpangulu te igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) ne punduk. Duen ded man-e daruwa ne pulu wey hep-at ne libu (24,000) ne sundalu te punduk din.

15 In the twelfth (12) month, Hilday from_Nitupa descendant of Utnil (was) the (one who) led the twelfth (12) group. There_were also twenty four thousand (24,000) soldiers in his group.

Ka me pangulu te me kabuhalan ni Israil

The leaders of the descendant(s) of Israil

16 Seini ka me pangulu te me kabuhalan ni Israil:

16 These (were) the leaders of the descendant(s) of Israil:

Ilisir child of Sikri (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Rubin.

Ne si Sipatiyas ne anak ni Maaka ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Simyun.

And Sipatiyas child of Maaka (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Simyun.

17 Ne si Hasabiyas ne anak ni Kimuil ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Libi.

17 And Hasabiyas child of Kimuil (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Libi.

And Saduk (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Aarun.

18 Ne si Ilihu ne sabeka te me suled ni Dabid ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Huda.

18 And Ilihu one of the siblings/cousins of Dabid (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Huda.

Ne si Umri ne anak ni Maykil ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Isakar.

And Umri child of Maykil (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Isakar.

19 Ne si Ismayas ne anak ni Ubadiya ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Sabulun.

19 And Ismayas child of Ubadiya (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Sabulun.

Ne si Hirimut ne anak ni Asril ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Naptali.

And Hirimut child of Asril (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Naptali.

20 Ne si Husiya ne anak ni Asasiyas ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Ipraim.

20 And Husiya child of Asasiyas (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Ipraim.

Ne si Huwil ne anak ni Pidayas ka pangulu te katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis.

And Huwil child of Pidayas (was) the leader of the half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) descendants of Manasis.

21 Ne si Idu ne anak ni Sakariyas ka pangulu te katenge te kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Manasis diye te Gilyad.

21 And Idu child of Sakariyas (was) the leader of the half of the descendant(s) of Husi that (were) descendants of Manasis there at Gilyad.

Ne si Hasil ne anak ni Abnir ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Binhamin.

And Hasil child of Abnir (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Binhamin.

22 Ne si Asaril ne anak ni Hiruham ka pangulu te kabuhalan ni Dan.

22 And Asaril child of Hiruham (was) the leader of the descendant(s) of Dan.

Sikandan ka me pangulu te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

They (were) the leaders of the descendant(s) of Israil.

23 [xr]Te pegsinsus ni Dabid te me matig-Israil, masulug ka me etew tenged su migsaad ma ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne egpamasuluhen din iling te me bituen ka me matig-Israil. Purisu iyan de impasinsus ni Dabid ka migdaruwa ne pulu (20) se idad wey subla. 24 [xr]Si Huwab ne anak ni Siruya ka migbunsud migpaninsus piru ware din neimpusi su nabelu ma ka Magbebaye ne Manama te pegpaninsus din. Purisu ware nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren ni Hari Dabid ka langun ne kasuluhan te me matig-Israil.

23 [xr]At the censusing by Dabid of the (ones) from_Israil, there were very many people because the Lord had promised to make the (ones) from_Israil as many as the stars in the sky. So/therefore Dabid counted only the people who were twenty (20) years in age and greater. 24 [xr]Huwab child of Siruya (was) the (one who) began censusing but he didn't finish (it) because the Lord God was_angry at his censusing. Therefore all the descendants of the (ones) from_Israil weren't written there in the Writing_document of the Stories of King Dabid.

Ka impamiyalan ni Hari Dabid

The (ones) entrusted(pl) by King Dabid

25 Ne si Asmabit ne anak ni Adiil iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te tahuanan te karatuan te Hari. Ne si Diyunatan ne anak ni Usiyas iyan impiyalan te me tahuanan te karatuan diye te me distritu, te me lungsud, te me bariyu, wey te me matikang ne baley. 26 Ne si Isri ne anak ni Kilub iyan impiyalan ne egbebantey te me talagbasuk diye te kamet te Hari. 27 Ne si Simii ne matig-Rama iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te parasan; ne si Sabdi iyan impiyalan te tahuanan te binu. 28 Ne si Baal-Hanan ne matig-Gidir iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te me kayu ne ulibu wey sikumuru diye te lenlen te me bubungan te Huda.[fn] Ne si Huwas iyan impiyalan te tahuanan te mentika te ulibu. 29 Ne si Sitray ne matig-Sarun iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te me ayam diye te panabtaban te Siyarun. Ne si Sapat ne anak ni Adlay iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te me ayam diye te me napu. 30 Ne si Ubil ne Ismailita iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te me kamil. Ne si Hidayas ne matig-Mirunut iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te me asnu. Ne si Hasis ne kabuhalan ni Hagar iyan impiyalan ne egbantey te me karniru. 31 Sikandan langun ka impiyalan ne egbantey te me karatuan ni Hari Dabid.

25 And Asmabit child of Adiil was_entrusted to_guard the storage_place of the wealth of the king. And Diyunatan child of Usiyas (was) entrusted with the storage_places of wealth there in the districts, towns, barrios, and tall houses. 26 And Isri child of Kilub was_entrusted to_guard the farm_workers there in the field(s) of the king. 27 And Simii from_Rama was_entrusted to_guard the vineyards; and Sabdi was_entrusted_with the storage_place of wine. 28 And Baal-Hanan from_Gidir was_entrusted to_guard the olive trees and sycamores there at the foot of the mountains of Huda.[fn] And Huwas was_ (the one) _entrusted_with the storage_place of olive oil. 29 And Sitray from_Sarun was_entrusted to_guard the domestic_animals there in the grazing_places of Sarun. And Sapat child of Adlay was_entrusted to_guard the domestic_animals there in the plains. 30 And Ubil the Ismailita was_entrusted to_guard the camels. And Hidayas from_Mirunut was_entrusted to_guard the donkeys. And Hasis the descendant of Hagar was_entrusted to_guard the sheep. 31 They all (were) the (ones) entrusted to_guard the wealth(pl) of King Dabid.

Ka me talagtambag ni Hari Dabid

The advisors of King Dabid

32 Ka talagtambag ni Hari Dabid iyan ka anggam din ne si Diyunatan. Matagseb si Diyunatan wey sabeka ne sikritari. Ne iyan degma talagpanulu te me anak te Hari si Hihil ne anak ni Hakmuni. 33 Ne si Ahitupil pad man-e ka lein ne talagtambag ni Hari Dabid, wey si Husay ne matig-Arak ne amana rin ne alukuy. 34 Te migpatey e si Ahitupil, si Huyada ne anak ni Binayas ka nakasubal kandin duma ki Abiyatar. Ne si Huwab ka kumandir te me sundalu te Hari.

32 The advisor of King Dabid (was) his uncle Diyunatan. Diyunatan (was) wise and a (LIT one) secretary. And Hihil child of Hakmuni (was) also teacher of the children of the king. 33 And Ahitupil still again (was) the other advisor of King Dabid, and Husay from_Arak (was) his close (LIT great) friend. 34 When Ahitupil died, Huyada child of Binayas (was) the (one who) replaced him along_with Abiyatar. And Huwab (was) the commander of the soldiers of the king.

Ka me planu ni Dabid te timplu

The plans of Dabid for the temple

281 Ne impalibulung ni Dabid diye te Hirusalim ka me pangulu te me matig-Israil—me pangulu te me tribu, me upisyal te me punduk ne migpamakey te Hari, me pangulu te linibu wey ginatus ne me sundalu, me piniyalan te me karatuan, me piniyalan te me ayam te Hari wey te me anak din, me upisyal diye te palasyu, me bahani, wey ka mabbulut ne me sundalu.

Ka me dasag para te timplu

The gifts for the temple

291 [xr]Ne migkahiyan ni Hari Dabid ka langun ne nalibulung ne keet-etawan, “Si Sulumun ne anak ku ne in-alam te Manama, bate pad wey ware pad kaligtahaan. Dakel ka himu su kene ne timplu re te etew, ke kene, timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 2 Purisu inggimu ku ka langun ne egkeyimu ku te pegpangandam te me kasangkapan ne eggamiten te peggimu te timplu te Manama ku—me bulawan, me pelata, me burunsi, me putew, me kayu, me batu ne egngaranan te uniks, imirald, me batu ne nalein-lein se me batek, wey me mateles amana ne me pahang. 3 Ne tenged te dakel ne geyinawa ku te timplu te Manama, egbehey a te keddi mismu ne bulawan wey pelata para te peggimu kayi, timul seini te langun ne nalimud ku para te matulus ne timplu. 4 Egbehey a te sabeka ne gatus ne libu (100,000) ne kilu ne bulawan ne egpuun te Upir, wey 240,000 ne kilu ne pelata. Eggamiten seini ne igbulit te me alabat te timplu, 5 wey para te langun ne me kasangkapan ne eggimuwen te me trabahanti. Ne kuntee, hentew kaniyu ka egkeupian ne egbehey te Magbebaye ne Manama?”

Ka guhuren te peghari ni Dabid

The story of the kinging by Dabid

26 Si Dabid ne anak ni Hisi mighari te intiru ne Israil, 27 [xr]te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un. Mighari sikandin diye te Hibrun te pitu ne leg-un, wey tatelu ne pulu wey tatelu (33) diye te Hirusalim. 28 Neuyag sikandin te malayat ne timpu, wey nakaangken te dakel ne karatuan wey kabantug. 26 Dabid child of Hisi kinged in entire Israil, 27 [xr]for forty (40) years. He kinged there in Hibrun for seven years, and thirty three (33) there in Hirusalim. 28 He lived for a long time, and received great (LIT big) wealth and honor. And he died very old and Sulumun his child replaced him to_king. 29 The story concerning the kinging by Dabid, from the first until the end, was_written there in the Writing_document of the Stories by prophet Samwil, by prophet Natan, and by prophet Gad. 30 The story concerning the kinging by Dabid, his honor, and all that happened to_him and to Israil, and to all the surrounding kingdoms were_written in that book.

28:2 Te Hibruwanen: peunturan te paa rin.

29:10 Te Hibruwanen: iyan inggamit ka “Israil” ne iyan ikarangeb ne ngaran ni Hakub.
